features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.

features.name: Signature Spells
features.text: Two level 3 spells from your book are always prepared and each can be cast once without a slot per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.text: Proficiency with Alchemist's Supplies and the Herbalism Kit, and potions take half the time to brew.

features.name: Alchemist Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Healing Word, Ray of Sickness. Level 5: Flaming Sphere, Melf's Acid Arrow. Level 9: Gaseous Form, Mass Healing Word. Level 13: Death Ward, Vitriolic Sphere. Level 17: Cloudkill, Raise Dead.

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.text: After a Long Rest, create random elixirs (healing, swiftness, resilience, boldness, flight, transformation); spend slots for more. More elixirs at 5th, 9th and 15th level.

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.text: When you cast a spell through Alchemist's Supplies, add Intelligence modifier to one roll that heals or deals Acid, Fire or Poison damage.

features.name: Restorative Reagents
features.text: Cast Lesser Restoration without a slot Intelligence modifier times per Long Rest.

features.name: Chemical Mastery
features.text: Resistance to Acid and Poison and immunity to Poisoned; your Acid, Fire or Poison spells deal an extra 2d8 Force once per turn; cast Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron free once per Long Rest.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.text: Heavy armor training and Smith's Tools proficiency; armor takes half the time to craft.

features.name: Armorer Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Magic Missile, Thunderwave. Level 5: Mirror Image, Shatter. Level 9: Hypnotic Pattern, Lightning Bolt. Level 13: Fire Shield, Greater Invisibility. Level 17: Passwall, Wall of Force.

features.name: Arcane Armor
features.text: Turn your armor into Arcane Armor: no Strength requirement, quick to don, and usable as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Armor Model
features.text: Choose Dreadnaught, Guardian or Infiltrator, each with a special Intelligence-based weapon; switch after a rest. Infiltrator also adds 5 feet of Speed.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Improved Armorer
features.text: Learn an extra Armor plan for Replicate Magic Item, and your model weapon gets +1 to attack and damage.

features.name: Perfected Armor
features.text: Your armor model's weapons deal more damage and each model gains extra abilities.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.text: Martial ranged weapon proficiency and Woodcarver's Tools; wands take half the time to craft.

features.name: Artillerist Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Shield, Thunderwave. Level 5: Scorching Ray, Shatter. Level 9: Fireball, Wind Wall. Level 13: Ice Storm, Wall of Fire. Level 17: Cone of Cold, Wall of Force.

features.name: Eldritch Cannon
features.text: As a Magic action, create a cannon for 1 hour with Flamethrower, Force Ballista or Protector modes, activated with a Bonus Action.

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.text: Carve a rod, staff, wand or ranged weapon into a focus that adds 1d8 to one damage roll of your Artificer spells.

features.name: Explosive Cannon
features.text: Your cannon deals more damage and can be detonated for a burst of Force damage.

features.name: Fortified Position
features.text: Maintain two cannons and activate both with one Bonus Action; allies near them have Half Cover.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.text: Smith's Tools proficiency; weapons take half the time to craft.

features.name: Battle Smith Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Heroism, Shield. Level 5: Shining Smite, Warding Bond. Level 9: Aura of Vitality, Conjure Barrage. Level 13: Aura of Purity, Fire Shield. Level 17: Banishing Smite, Mass Cure Wounds.

features.name: Battle Ready
features.text: Martial weapon proficiency, and you can use Intelligence for magic weapon attacks and damage; a weapon can be your focus.

features.name: Steel Defender
features.text: Gain a construct companion that acts on your turn and Dodges unless you command it with a Bonus Action.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice when you take the Attack action, or replace one attack with a command to your Steel Defender.

features.name: Arcane Jolt
features.text: Once per turn, when your magic weapon or defender hits, deal 2d6 extra Force or heal a creature 2d6. Intelligence modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Defender
features.text: Arcane Jolt becomes 4d6, and your defender's Deflect Attack damages the attacker.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.text: Proficiency with Calligrapher's Supplies and Cartographer's Tools; scrolls take half the time to scribe.

features.name: Cartographer Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Faerie Fire, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word. Level 5: Locate Object, Mind Spike. Level 9: Call Lightning, Clairvoyance. Level 13: Banishment, Locate Creature. Level 17: Scrying, Teleportation Circle.

features.name: Adventurer's Atlas
features.text: After a Long Rest, create magical maps for your allies: holders add 1d4 to Initiative and know each other's locations.

features.name: Scouting Magic
features.text: Cast Faerie Fire without a slot Intelligence modifier times per Long Rest, and use Portal Jump to teleport short distances by spending movement.

features.name: Guided Precision
features.text: Once per turn, add Intelligence modifier to damage of your Cartographer spells or against Faerie Fire targets; damage can't break Faerie Fire.

features.name: Ingenious Movement
features.text: When you use Flash of Genius, you can also teleport yourself or an ally up to 30 feet.

features.name: Superior Atlas
features.text: A map holder that drops to 0 HP can destroy the map to return with twice your Artificer level in HP, and you can cast Find the Path free once per Long Rest.

features.name: Reanimator Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: False Life, Spare the Dying, Witch Bolt. Level 5: Blindness/Deafness, Enhance Ability. Level 9: Animate Dead, Lightning Bolt. Level 13: Blight, Death Ward. Level 17: Antilife Shell, Raise Dead.

features.name: Reanimator's Tools
features.text: Proficiency with Alchemist's Supplies.

features.name: Reanimator's Skill Set
features.text: Spare the Dying can revive a creature with HP equal to your Artificer level and shock nearby creatures. Intelligence modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Reanimated Companion
features.text: As a Magic action, create an undead companion that obeys you until a Long Rest or until dismissed.

features.name: Strange Modifications
features.text: Each new companion gets a modification such as Arcane Conduit or Ferocity.

features.name: Improved Reanimation
features.text: Companions get two modifications, their Death Burst deals 4d4, and their Necrotic damage ignores resistance.

features.name: Superior Reanimation
features.text: Companions get three modifications, you can cast Raise Dead once per Long Rest without a slot, and you can sacrifice your companion to heal yourself.

features.name: Frenzy
features.text: When you use Reckless Attack while raging, your first Strength hit each turn deals extra d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.text: While raging, you're immune to Charmed and Frightened, and entering Rage ends them.

features.name: Retaliation
features.text: When a creature within 5 feet damages you, use a Reaction to make a melee attack against it.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.text: As a Bonus Action, frighten creatures of your choice within 30 feet on a failed Wisdom save. Once per Long Rest or a Rage use.

features.name: Animal Speaker
features.text: Cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as rituals using Wisdom.

features.name: Rage of the Wilds
features.text: Each time you rage, choose Bear (resist almost all damage), Eagle (Dash and Disengage as a Bonus Action) or Wolf (allies have advantage against foes next to you).

features.name: Aspect of the Wilds
features.text: Choose Owl (Darkvision 60 feet), Panther (Climb Speed) or Salmon (Swim Speed); change after a Long Rest.

features.name: Nature Speaker
features.text: Cast Commune with Nature as a ritual using Wisdom.

features.name: Power of the Wilds
features.text: Each time you rage, choose Falcon (fly while unarmored), Lion (enemies near you have disadvantage attacking others) or Ram (knock creatures Prone on hit).

features.name: Vitality Surge
features.text: When you enter Rage, gain temp HP equal to your Barbarian level.

features.name: Life-Giving Force
features.text: At the start of each of your turns while raging, give an ally within 10 feet temp HP equal to d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

features.name: Branches of the Tree
features.text: As a Reaction while raging, teleport a creature that starts its turn within 30 feet next to you on a failed Strength save, setting its Speed to 0.

features.name: Battering Roots
features.text: Your Heavy or Versatile melee weapons gain 10 feet of reach on your turn and can apply Push or Topple in addition to another mastery.

features.name: Travel along the Tree
features.text: When you rage or as a Bonus Action while raging, teleport 60 feet; once per Rage, teleport 150 feet with up to six willing creatures.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.text: While raging, your first hit each turn deals extra 1d6 + half your Barbarian level Necrotic or Radiant damage.

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.text: A pool of d12s you can spend as a Bonus Action to heal yourself; it grows at 6th, 12th and 17th level and refills on a Long Rest.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.text: Once per Rage, reroll a failed save with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.text: As a Bonus Action, up to ten creatures within 60 feet gain advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn. Once per Long Rest or a Rage use.

features.name: Rage of the Gods
features.text: Once per Long Rest, when you rage, take a divine form for 1 minute: fly, resist Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant, and spend Rage uses to save creatures from dropping to 0 HP.

features.name: Dazzling Footwork
features.text: While unarmored and without a shield: advantage on dancing Performance checks, AC of 10 + Dexterity modifier + Charisma modifier, Dexterity unarmed strikes using your Bardic Inspiration die for damage, and an Unarmed Strike when you spend Bardic Inspiration.

features.name: Inspiring Movement
features.text: When an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you, spend a Reaction and a Bardic Inspiration use to move half your Speed, and an ally can do the same.

features.name: Tandem Footwork
features.text: When you roll Initiative, spend a Bardic Inspiration use to add the die to the Initiative of you and allies within 30 feet.

features.name: Leading Evasion
features.text: On Dexterity saves for half damage, take none on a success and half on a failure; nearby creatures making the same save share it.

features.name: Beguiling Magic
features.text: Charm Person and Mirror Image are always prepared. After casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with a slot, charm or frighten a creature within 60 feet on a failed Wisdom save. Once per Long Rest or a Bardic Inspiration use.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.text: As a Bonus Action, spend Bardic Inspiration to give allies temp HP equal to twice the roll and let them move without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.text: Command is always prepared. As a Bonus Action, cast it without a slot and keep casting it each turn for 1 minute. Once per Long Rest or a level 3+ slot.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.text: As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute the first creature that attacks you each turn must succeed on a Charisma save or miss. Once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.text: Proficiency in three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.text: As a Reaction, spend a Bardic Inspiration die to subtract it from a creature's attack roll, ability check or damage roll within 60 feet.

features.name: Magical Discoveries
features.text: Learn two spells from the Cleric, Druid or Wizard lists; they are always prepared.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.text: When you fail an ability check or attack roll, add a Bardic Inspiration die; it's spent only if you then succeed.

features.name: Guiding Whispers
features.text: You know Guidance, and its range is 60 feet for you.

features.name: Spiritual Focus
features.text: Use a card set, crystal, candle or ink pen as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Spirits from Beyond
features.text: When you give Bardic Inspiration, you can roll to channel a random spirit (or spend a use to choose one) and later unleash it on a creature within 30 feet as a Magic action.

features.name: Power from Beyond
features.text: Once per turn, add 1d6 to damage or healing of a Bard spell cast with a slot.

features.name: Spiritual Manifestation
features.text: Spirit Guardians is always prepared and castable once per Long Rest without a slot, optionally granting Half Cover to allies inside.

features.name: Mystical Connection
features.text: When you roll for Spirits from Beyond, roll twice and choose; doubles let you pick any spirit.

features.name: Inspired Eclipse
features.text: When you give Bardic Inspiration, you can also turn Invisible and teleport 30 feet.

features.name: Lunar Vitality
features.text: Once per turn, when a spell restores HP, spend a Bardic Inspiration die to add healing and give the target +10 feet of Speed.

features.name: Primal Lore
features.text: Learn Druidic and one Druid cantrip, and gain proficiency in one nature-related skill.

features.name: Blessing of Moonlight
features.text: Moonbeam is always prepared; once per Long Rest, your Moonbeam can also heal an ally when an enemy fails its save.

features.name: Eclipse and Full Moon
features.text: Inspired Eclipse also lets the ally turn Invisible and teleport, and Lunar Vitality can use a d6 instead of spending a die.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.text: A creature with your Bardic Inspiration die can add it to a weapon damage roll or to its AC against an attack.

features.name: Martial Training
features.text: Proficiency with Martial weapons, Medium armor and Shields; a weapon can be your spellcasting focus.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice when you take the Attack action, and you can replace one attack with a cantrip that takes an action.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.text: After casting a spell that takes an action, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Arcana Domain Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Detect Magic, Magic Missile, Magic Weapon, Nystul's Magic Aura. Level 5: Counterspell, Dispel Magic. Level 7: Arcane Eye, Leomund's Secret Chest. Level 9: Bigby's Hand, Teleportation Circle.

features.name: Modify Magic
features.text: When you cast a spell, spend Channel Divinity to grant 2d8 + Cleric level temp HP, or make a target subtract 1d6 from its first save.

features.name: Student of Arcana
features.text: Gain Arcana or another Cleric skill and learn two Wizard cantrips, swapping one when you gain a Cleric level.

features.name: Dispelling Recovery
features.text: After casting a healing or condition-ending spell with a slot, cast Dispel Magic without a slot once per rest or by spending Channel Divinity.

features.name: Magical Mastery
features.text: Learn one Wizard spell of each level 6 to 9; they are always prepared.

features.name: Grave Domain Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Detect Evil and Good, False Life, Gentle Repose, Ray of Enfeeblement, Spare the Dying. Level 5: Revivify, Vampiric Touch. Level 7: Blight, Death Ward. Level 9: Dispel Evil and Good, Raise Dead.

features.name: Pull of Death
features.text: Once per turn, when you damage a creature missing HP with a spell or attack roll, add Necrotic damage (1d4, 1d6 at 11th).

features.name: Return to Life
features.text: Cast Spare the Dying as a Bonus Action, and healing dice for creatures at 0 HP use their maximum.

features.name: Path to the Grave
features.text: As a Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity to curse a creature within 30 feet: disadvantage on attacks and saves; a hit can end it for extra damage equal to your Cleric level.

features.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
features.text: As a Reaction, halve the damage of an attack against you or a Bloodied creature within 60 feet and cancel critical extras. Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Enhanced Necromancy
features.text: Spend Channel Divinity to make a single-target Necromancy spell affect a second creature.

features.name: Keeper of Souls
features.text: When an enemy dies within 60 feet, you or a creature you see regains HP equal to twice your Cleric level. Once per rest or a level 6+ slot.

features.name: Blessings of Knowledge
features.text: Proficiency with one Artisan's Tool and two of Arcana, History, Nature or Religion, with Expertise in those two.

features.name: Knowledge Domain Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Command, Comprehend Languages, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Identify, Mind Spike. Level 5: Dispel Magic, Nondetection, Tongues. Level 7: Arcane Eye, Banishment, Confusion. Level 9: Legend Lore, Scrying, Synaptic Static.

features.name: Mind Magic
features.text: As a Magic action, spend Channel Divinity to cast a Divination domain spell without a slot or material components.

features.name: Unfettered Mind
features.text: Telepathy 60 feet with up to Wisdom modifier creatures, plus Intelligence save proficiency (or another you lack).

features.name: Divine Foreknowledge
features.text: As a Bonus Action, gain advantage on d20 Tests for 1 hour. Once per Long Rest or a level 6+ slot.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.text: When a spell cast with a slot restores HP, the creature regains an extra 2 + the slot's level.

features.name: Life Domain Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration. Level 5: Mass Healing Word, Revivify. Level 7: Aura of Life, Death Ward. Level 9: Greater Restoration, Mass Cure Wounds.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.text: As a Magic action, spend Channel Divinity to divide five times your Cleric level in healing among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet, up to half their HP max.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.text: When you heal another creature with a slot spell, you regain 2 + the slot's level.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.text: Healing dice from your spells and Channel Divinity always roll their maximum.

features.name: Light Domain Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Burning Hands, Faerie Fire, Scorching Ray, See Invisibility. Level 5: Daylight, Fireball. Level 7: Arcane Eye, Wall of Fire. Level 9: Flame Strike, Scrying.

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
features.text: As a Magic action, spend Channel Divinity to dispel magical darkness within 30 feet and deal Radiant damage to chosen creatures (Constitution save for half).

features.name: Warding Flare
features.text: As a Reaction, impose disadvantage on an attack against a creature within 30 feet. Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Warding Flare
features.text: Warding Flare recharges on a Short Rest too and grants temp HP to the protected creature.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.text: As a Magic action, emit sunlight for 1 minute; enemies in it have disadvantage on saves against your Radiance of the Dawn and Fire or Radiant spells. Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.text: As a Magic action, give yourself or a willing creature advantage on Stealth checks until your next Long Rest.

features.name: Trickery Domain Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Charm Person, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Pass without Trace. Level 5: Hypnotic Pattern, Nondetection. Level 7: Confusion, Dimension Door. Level 9: Dominate Person, Modify Memory.

features.name: Invoke Duplicity
features.text: As a Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity to create an illusory double for 1 minute: cast spells from its space and gain advantage against creatures near it.

features.name: Trickster's Transposition
features.text: When you create or move your illusion, you can teleport to swap places with it.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.text: You and allies have advantage against creatures within 5 feet of the illusion, and when it ends, a creature regains HP equal to your Cleric level.

features.name: Guided Strike
features.text: Spend Channel Divinity to add +10 to a missed attack roll by you or a creature within 30 feet.

features.name: War Domain Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Guiding Bolt, Magic Weapon, Shield of Faith, Spiritual Weapon. Level 5: Crusader's Mantle, Spirit Guardians. Level 7: Fire Shield, Freedom of Movement. Level 9: Hold Monster, Steel Wind Strike.

features.name: War Priest
features.text: As a Bonus Action, make one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike. Wisdom modifier uses per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: War God's Blessing
features.text: Spend Channel Divinity to cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a slot or Concentration for 1 minute.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.text: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

features.name: Circle of the Land Spells
features.text: After each Long Rest, choose a land; its spells are always prepared. Arid: Blur, Burning Hands, Fire Bolt / Fireball / Blight / Wall of Stone. Polar: Fog Cloud, Hold Person, Ray of Frost / Sleet Storm / Ice Storm / Cone of Cold. Temperate: Misty Step, Shocking Grasp, Sleep / Lightning Bolt / Freedom of Movement / Tree Stride. Tropical: Acid Splash, Ray of Sickness, Web / Stinking Cloud / Polymorph / Insect Plague (levels 3, 5, 7, 9).

features.name: Land's Aid
features.text: As a Magic action, spend a Wild Shape use to make a 10-foot burst that damages foes (Constitution save) and heals one creature. Scales at 10th and 14th level.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.text: Cast one prepared Circle spell without a slot once per Long Rest, and recover spell slots on a Short Rest up to half your Druid level.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.text: Immune to Poisoned and resistant to your current land's damage type.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.text: Spend a Wild Shape use to raise a 15-foot cube of spectral trees for 1 minute that grants Half Cover and your Nature's Ward resistance to allies.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.text: Wild Shape into beasts up to CR equal to Druid level / 3; your AC can be 13 + Wisdom modifier, and you gain temp HP equal to three times your Druid level.

features.name: Circle of the Moon Spells
features.text: Always prepared and castable in Wild Shape. Level 3: Cure Wounds, Moonbeam, Starry Wisp. Level 5: Conjure Animals. Level 7: Fount of Moonlight. Level 9: Mass Cure Wounds.

features.name: Improved Circle Forms
features.text: In Wild Shape, your attacks can deal Radiant damage and you add Wisdom modifier to Constitution saves.

features.name: Moonlight Step
features.text: As a Bonus Action, teleport up to 30 feet and gain advantage on your next attack this turn. Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest or by spending slots.

features.name: Lunar Form
features.text: Once per turn, Wild Shape attacks deal an extra 2d10 Radiant, and Moonlight Step can bring a willing creature along.

features.name: Circle of the Sea Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Shatter, Thunderwave. Level 5: Lightning Bolt, Water Breathing. Level 7: Control Water, Ice Storm. Level 9: Conjure Elemental, Hold Monster.

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
features.text: Spend a Wild Shape use to surround yourself with a 5-foot emanation of ocean spray for 10 minutes; as a Bonus Action, deal Cold damage and push a creature in it.

features.name: Aquatic Affinity
features.text: The emanation grows to 10 feet, and you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Stormborn
features.text: While your emanation is active, gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and resistance to Cold, Lightning and Thunder.

features.name: Oceanic Gift
features.text: Place the emanation on a willing creature within 60 feet instead of yourself, or spend two uses to affect both of you.

features.name: Star Map
features.text: Your star chart is a focus; Guidance and Guiding Bolt are always prepared, and you can cast Guiding Bolt without a slot Wisdom modifier times per Long Rest.

features.name: Starry Form
features.text: Spend a Wild Shape use to take a starry form for 10 minutes with a constellation: Archer (ranged radiant attack), Chalice (extra healing) or Dragon (minimum 10 on concentration and Int or Wis checks).

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.text: After a Long Rest, roll a die: even (Weal) lets you add 1d6 to a creature's d20 Test, odd (Woe) subtract 1d6. Wisdom modifier uses.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.text: Archer and Chalice use 2d8, Dragon grants a 20-foot Fly Speed with hover, and you can change constellations each turn.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.text: In Starry Form, you resist Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

features.name: Arcane Archer Lore
features.text: Learn Druidcraft or Prestidigitation (Intelligence) and gain proficiency in Arcana or Nature.

features.name: Arcane Shot
features.text: Learn two Arcane Shot options; once per turn, when you hit with ammunition, apply one. Intelligence modifier uses per Short or Long Rest; more options as you level.

features.name: Curving Shot
features.text: When you miss with a magic arrow, use a Bonus Action to reroll the attack against a different target within 60 feet.

features.name: Magical Ammunition
features.text: As an action, imbue ammunition to create darkness, unlock an object or grow a climbable vine. Once per rest or by spending a Second Wind use.

features.name: Ever-Ready Shot
features.text: When you roll Initiative, regain one Arcane Shot use.

features.name: Indomitable Teleport
features.text: When you succeed on a save using Indomitable, teleport up to 60 feet.

features.name: Masterful Shots
features.text: When a creature you can see misses you, use a Reaction to move half your Speed and possibly attack it with a ranged weapon.

features.name: Knightly Envoy
features.text: Cast Comprehend Languages as a ritual with Charisma, learn a language, and gain proficiency in a social skill.

features.name: Group Recovery
features.text: When you use Second Wind, up to Charisma modifier allies within 30 feet regain 1d4 + Fighter level HP. Once per rest.

features.name: Team Tactics
features.text: Allies who regain HP from Group Recovery have advantage on d20 Tests until your next turn.

features.name: Rallying Surge
features.text: When you use Action Surge, up to Charisma modifier allies within 30 feet can use a Reaction to attack or move half their Speed.

features.name: Shared Resilience
features.text: When an ally within 60 feet fails a save, spend an Indomitable use to let them reroll with a bonus equal to your Fighter level.

features.name: Inspiring Commander
features.text: Group Recovery and Rallying Surge reach 60 feet, and you're immune to Charmed and Frightened.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.text: Learn three maneuvers and gain four d8 Superiority Dice that return on a Short or Long Rest; more maneuvers and dice as you level.

features.name: Student of War
features.text: Proficiency with one Artisan's Tool and one Fighter skill.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.text: As a Bonus Action, learn a creature's immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities. Once per Long Rest or a Superiority Die.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.text: Your Superiority Dice become d10s.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: Once per turn, use a d8 instead of spending a Superiority Die.

features.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
features.text: Your Superiority Dice become d12s.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.text: Your weapon attacks and Unarmed Strikes score a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.text: Advantage on Initiative and Athletics checks, and after a Critical Hit you can move half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.text: Gain another Fighting Style feat.

features.name: Heroic Warrior
features.text: In combat, gain Heroic Inspiration at the start of your turn if you don't have it.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.text: Your attacks score a Critical Hit on an 18 to 20.

features.name: Survivor
features.text: Advantage on Death Saves (18 to 20 counts as a 20), and while Bloodied you regain 5 + Constitution modifier HP at the start of your turns.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: Learn Wizard cantrips and prepare Wizard spells cast with Intelligence. The app sets this class as a Third caster with INT when you choose this subclass.

features.name: War Bond
features.text: Bond with up to two weapons in a 1-hour ritual; you can't be disarmed of them and can summon one to your hand as a Bonus Action.

features.name: War Magic
features.text: When you take the Attack action, replace one attack with a Wizard cantrip that takes an action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.text: When you hit with a weapon, the target has disadvantage on its next save against your spells before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.text: When you use Action Surge, teleport up to 30 feet.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.text: When you take the Attack action, replace two attacks with a level 1 or 2 Wizard spell that takes an action.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.text: Gain Psionic Energy Dice that fuel this subclass and return on rests: Protective Field (reduce damage), Psionic Strike (extra Force damage) and Telekinetic Movement (move objects or creatures).

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.text: Psi-Powered Leap gives a Fly Speed of twice your Speed for the turn, and Telekinetic Thrust can knock targets Prone or push them.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.text: Resistance to Psychic damage, and you can spend a die to end Charmed or Frightened on yourself.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.text: As a Bonus Action, give up to Intelligence modifier creatures Half Cover for 1 minute. Once per Long Rest or a die.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.text: Telekinesis is always prepared and castable without a slot; while concentrating on it, make a weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Despairing Strikes
features.text: Spend a die after a weapon hit to add Psychic damage and an optional rider effect; dice return on a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Solemn Gaze
features.text: Gain Darkvision 60 feet (or +60), and a few times per Long Rest sense a creature's dominant emotion on a failed Wisdom save.

features.name: Dreaded Appearance
features.text: Tactical Shift can teleport you 30 feet, and nearby enemies take Psychic damage and become Frightened on a failed Wisdom save. Once per rest.

features.name: Unsettled Strikes
features.text: New Despairing Strike riders: Apathetic (Incapacitated), Lost (Blinded and Speed 0) and Weary (Exhaustion, up to 2).

features.name: Grim Constitution
features.text: Resistance to Necrotic and Psychic damage, and a Constitution save can stop effects that reduce your HP maximum.

features.name: Grieving Mantle
features.text: After Action Surge, for 1 minute you're immune to Charmed and Frightened and can use a Reaction to turn insubstantial and negate an attack's damage.

features.name: Hand of Harm
features.text: Once per turn, when you hit with an Unarmed Strike, spend 1 Focus Point to add Necrotic damage equal to a Martial Arts die + Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Hand of Healing
features.text: As a Magic action, spend 1 Focus Point to heal a creature a Martial Arts die + Wisdom modifier; you can replace a Flurry of Blows strike with it.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.text: Proficiency in Insight, Medicine and the Herbalism Kit.

features.name: Physician's Touch
features.text: Hand of Harm can also Poison the target, and Hand of Healing can end Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned or Stunned.

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
features.text: Replace Flurry of Blows strikes with free Hand of Healing uses and add Hand of Harm without Focus Points. Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
features.text: Spend 5 Focus Points to revive a creature that died within 24 hours with 4d10 + Wisdom modifier HP. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.text: Spend 1 Focus Point to cast Darkness without components (you see through it and can move it), gain Darkvision 60 feet, and learn Minor Illusion with Wisdom.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.text: While in dim light or darkness, as a Bonus Action, teleport up to 60 feet to another dim or dark space and gain advantage on your next melee attack.

features.name: Improved Shadow Step
features.text: Spend 1 Focus Point to Shadow Step without the light requirement and make an Unarmed Strike right after.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.text: As a Magic action in dim light or darkness, spend 3 Focus Points to become Invisible and partly incorporeal for 1 minute, using Flurry of Blows for free.

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.text: At the start of your turn, spend 1 Focus Point for 10 minutes: +10 feet reach on unarmed strikes, elemental damage, and pushes or pulls on hits.

features.name: Manipulate Elements
features.text: You know Elementalism, cast with Wisdom.

features.name: Elemental Burst
features.text: As a Magic action, spend 2 Focus Points for a 20-foot-radius blast of three Martial Arts dice of elemental damage (Dexterity save for half).

features.name: Stride of the Elements
features.text: While Elemental Attunement is active, you have Fly and Swim Speeds equal to your Speed.

features.name: Elemental Epitome
features.text: While attuned: resist a chosen element, Step of the Wind adds 20 feet of Speed, and your strikes and movement deal extra elemental damage.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: Learn Sorcerer cantrips and prepare Sorcerer spells cast with Wisdom. The app sets this class as a Third caster with WIS when you choose this subclass.

features.name: Mystic Fighting Style
features.text: When you take the Attack action, replace one unarmed strike with a Sorcerer cantrip that takes an action.

features.name: Mystic Focus
features.text: Spend a spell slot to regain Focus Points equal to its level, or spend Focus Points to recover slots up to level 4 on a Short Rest or with Uncanny Metabolism.

features.name: Focused Strike
features.text: After you use Stunning Strike, the target has disadvantage on saves against your spells until your next turn.

features.name: Improved Mystic Fighting Style
features.text: When you use Flurry of Blows, replace two strikes with a level 1 or 2 Sorcerer spell that takes an action.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.text: When you hit with a Flurry of Blows strike, choose: the target can't make Opportunity Attacks, is pushed 15 feet, or is knocked Prone on a failed save.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.text: As a Bonus Action, regain HP equal to a Martial Arts die roll + Wisdom modifier. Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Fleet Step
features.text: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.text: When you hit with an Unarmed Strike, spend 4 Focus Points to set lethal vibrations; later end them to deal 10d12 Force damage (half on a Constitution save).

features.name: Oath of Devotion Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith. Level 5: Aid, Zone of Truth. Level 9: Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic. Level 13: Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith. Level 17: Commune, Flame Strike.

features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.text: When you take the Attack action, spend Channel Divinity to empower your melee weapon for 10 minutes: add Charisma modifier to attacks, it sheds light, and can deal Radiant damage.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.text: You and allies in your Aura of Protection are immune to Charmed.

features.name: Smite of Protection
features.text: When you cast Divine Smite, you and allies in your aura gain Half Cover until your next turn.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.text: As a Bonus Action, for 10 minutes your aura sheds sunlight, damages enemies that start there, and gives advantage on saves against fiends and undead. Once per Long Rest or a level 5 slot.

features.name: Oath of Glory Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Guiding Bolt, Heroism. Level 5: Enhance Ability, Magic Weapon. Level 9: Haste, Protection from Energy. Level 13: Compulsion, Freedom of Movement. Level 17: Legend Lore, Yolande's Regal Presence.

features.name: Inspiring Smite
features.text: After casting Divine Smite, spend Channel Divinity to share 2d8 + Paladin level temp HP among creatures within 30 feet.

features.name: Peerless Athlete
features.text: As a Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity for 1 hour of advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics and longer jumps.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.text: Your Speed increases by 10 feet, and allies who start their turn in your aura gain the same bonus.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.text: As a Reaction, add your Charisma modifier to AC for you or an ally against an attack; if it misses, you can attack the attacker. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Living Legend
features.text: As a Bonus Action, for 10 minutes gain advantage on Charisma checks, turn a miss into a hit once per turn, and reroll failed saves. Once per Long Rest or a level 5 slot.

features.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Ensnaring Strike, Speak with Animals. Level 5: Misty Step, Moonbeam. Level 9: Plant Growth, Protection from Energy. Level 13: Ice Storm, Stoneskin. Level 17: Commune with Nature, Tree Stride.

features.name: Nature's Wrath
features.text: Spend Channel Divinity: creatures of your choice within 15 feet make a Strength save or are Restrained by vines for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.text: You and allies in your aura resist Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.text: When you drop to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP instead and heal. Once per Long Rest. You also stop showing signs of age.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.text: As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute regain 10 HP each turn, cast action spells as Bonus Actions, and enemies in your aura have disadvantage on saves against your spells. Once per Long Rest or a level 5 slot.

features.name: Oath of the Noble Genies Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Chromatic Orb, Elementalism, Thunderous Smite. Level 5: Mirror Image, Phantasmal Force. Level 9: Fly, Gaseous Form. Level 13: Conjure Minor Elementals, Summon Elemental. Level 17: Banishing Smite, Contact Other Plane.

features.name: Elemental Smite
features.text: After casting Divine Smite, spend Channel Divinity to add an elemental effect: restrain, teleport, burn nearby foes, or push.

features.name: Genie's Splendor
features.text: Without armor, your AC is 10 + Dexterity modifier + Charisma modifier (shields still apply), and you gain one of Acrobatics, Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Aura of Elemental Shielding
features.text: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder each turn; you and allies in your aura resist it.

features.name: Elemental Rebuke
features.text: As a Reaction, halve an attack's damage and force a Dexterity save or the attacker takes 2d10 + Charisma modifier elemental damage. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Noble Scion
features.text: As a Bonus Action, for 10 minutes gain a 60-foot Fly Speed with hover and turn a failed d20 Test of yours or an ally's into a success with a Reaction. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Bane, Hunter's Mark. Level 5: Hold Person, Misty Step. Level 9: Haste, Protection from Energy. Level 13: Banishment, Dimension Door. Level 17: Hold Monster, Scrying.

features.name: Vow of Enmity
features.text: When you take the Attack action, spend Channel Divinity to get advantage on attacks against a creature for 1 minute; you can move the vow if it drops to 0 HP.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.text: When you hit with an Opportunity Attack, reduce the target's Speed to 0 and move up to half your Speed as part of the Reaction.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.text: When the target of your Vow of Enmity attacks, use your Reaction to make a melee attack against it.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.text: As a Bonus Action, for 10 minutes gain a 60-foot Fly Speed with hover and a frightening aura. Once per Long Rest or a level 5 slot.

features.name: Primal Companion
features.text: Summon a Beast of the Land, Sea or Sky that acts on your turn; it Dodges unless you use a Bonus Action to command it. You can revive or replace it.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.text: Your command can also make the beast Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help, and its hits can deal Force damage.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.text: When you command Beast's Strike, the beast attacks twice, and its first hit each turn on your Hunter's Mark target deals extra Force damage.

features.name: Share Spells
features.text: When you cast a spell targeting yourself, it can also affect your beast within 30 feet.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.text: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals extra Psychic damage (1d4, 1d6 from 11th level).

features.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Charm Person. Level 5: Misty Step. Level 9: Summon Fey. Level 13: Dimension Door. Level 17: Mislead.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.text: Add your Wisdom modifier to Charisma checks and gain proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
features.text: Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened, and when a creature near you resists one, use a Reaction to charm or frighten another creature.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.text: Cast Summon Fey without material components, once per Long Rest without a slot, optionally without Concentration for 1 minute.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.text: Cast Misty Step without a slot Wisdom modifier times per Long Rest, and bring a willing creature with you.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.text: Add Wisdom modifier to Initiative; on your first turn of combat your Speed increases by 10 feet; once per turn add Dreadful Strike psychic damage (Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest).

features.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Disguise Self. Level 5: Rope Trick. Level 9: Fear. Level 13: Greater Invisibility. Level 17: Seeming.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.text: Gain Darkvision 60 feet (or +60), and you are invisible to creatures relying on Darkvision to see you in darkness.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.text: Proficiency in Wisdom saves, or Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it.

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.text: Dreadful Strike becomes 2d8 and adds Sudden Strike (extra attack nearby) or Mass Fear (frighten nearby creatures).

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.text: When attacked, use a Reaction to impose disadvantage and then teleport up to 30 feet.

features.name: Hollow Warden Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Wrathful Smite. Level 5: Alter Self. Level 9: Phantom Steed. Level 13: Dominate Beast. Level 17: Steel Wind Strike.

features.name: Wrath of the Wild
features.text: As a Bonus Action, spend a Favored Enemy use to take a monstrous form for 1 minute: +1 AC (+2 at 11th), opportunity attacks when nearby creatures hurt allies, and an aura that frightens on a failed Wisdom save.

features.name: Hungering Might
features.text: Add Wisdom modifier to Constitution saves; while transformed and Bloodied, your hits heal you once per turn.

features.name: Menacing Aura
features.text: Creatures that fail your aura's save also can't regain HP or take Reactions.

features.name: Strangling Roots
features.text: Add the Sap or Slow mastery property to your weapon hits along with another mastery.

features.name: Ominous Strikes
features.text: Your hits against Frightened creatures add your Wisdom modifier to damage.

features.name: Persistent Wrath
features.text: While transformed, if you drop to 0 HP you instead return to HP equal to twice your Ranger level. Once per Long Rest or a level 4+ slot.

features.name: Timeless
features.text: You are immune to Exhaustion.

features.name: Hunter's Lore
features.text: You know the immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities of creatures marked by your Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.text: Choose Colossus Slayer (extra 1d8 once per turn on a damaged target) or Horde Breaker (an extra attack against a second nearby creature). Swap after a rest.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.text: Choose Escape the Horde (opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage) or Multiattack Defense (after a hit, the attacker's other attacks have disadvantage). Swap after a rest.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
features.text: Once per turn, when you damage your marked target, deal Hunter's Mark's extra damage to another creature within 30 feet of it.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.text: When you take damage, use a Reaction to gain resistance to that damage type for the rest of the turn.

features.name: Frigid Explorer
features.text: Your Ranger attacks and spells ignore Cold resistance, you resist Cold, and once per turn your weapon hits add Cold damage (1d4, 1d6 at 11th).

features.name: Hunter's Rime
features.text: When you cast Hunter's Mark, gain 1d10 + Ranger level temp HP, and the marked creature can't Disengage.

features.name: Winter Walker Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Ice Knife. Level 5: Hold Person. Level 9: Remove Curse. Level 13: Ice Storm. Level 17: Cone of Cold.

features.name: Fortifying Soul
features.text: As a Magic action, heal up to Wisdom modifier allies 1d10 + Ranger level and give them advantage against Frightened for 1 hour. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Chilling Retribution
features.text: When an attack hits you, use a Reaction: the attacker makes a Wisdom save or is Stunned with Speed 0 until the end of your next turn. Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Frozen Haunt
features.text: When you cast Hunter's Mark, take a ghostly snow form: Cold immunity, a damaging 15-foot aura, and movement through creatures and objects. Once per Long Rest or a level 4+ slot.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You learn Wizard cantrips and prepare Wizard spells cast with Intelligence. The app sets this class as a Third caster with INT when you choose this subclass.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.text: Cast Mage Hand as a Bonus Action and make the hand invisible; you can use it for Sleight of Hand checks.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.text: If you are Invisible when you cast a spell on a creature, it has disadvantage on saves against that spell this turn.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.text: When you use Cunning Strike's Trip, you can also target a creature within 5 feet of your Mage Hand.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.text: When a creature casts a spell targeting or including you, use a Reaction to force an Intelligence save; on a failure the spell fails against you and you can steal it for 8 hours. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Assassinate
features.text: Advantage on Initiative, and in the first round you have advantage against creatures that haven't acted, adding your Rogue level to Sneak Attack damage.

features.name: Assassin's Tools
features.text: You gain a Disguise Kit and a Poisoner's Kit and proficiency with both.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.text: Mimic another person's voice and handwriting after studying them for an hour; Steady Aim no longer drops your Speed to 0.

features.name: Envenom Weapons
features.text: Cunning Strike's Poison option also deals 2d6 Poison damage that ignores resistance.

features.name: Death Strike
features.text: When you Sneak Attack in the first round, the target makes a Constitution save or the attack's damage is doubled.

features.name: Wails from the Grave
features.text: After dealing Sneak Attack on your turn, deal Necrotic damage to a second creature within 30 feet equal to half your Sneak Attack dice. Dexterity modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Whispers of the Dead
features.text: When you finish a rest, gain proficiency in one skill or tool of your choice until you choose a different one.

features.name: Tokens of the Departed
features.text: Keep soul trinkets that grant advantage on Death Saves and Constitution saves and fuel extra uses of Wails from the Grave.

features.name: Voice of Death
features.text: Cast Speak with Dead once per rest without a slot or components, even through a soul trinket.

features.name: Ghost Walk
features.text: As a Bonus Action, become spectral for 10 minutes: fly 10 feet, move through creatures and objects, and impose disadvantage on attacks against you.

features.name: Death's Friend
features.text: Wails from the Grave damages both targets, and you get a soul trinket when you roll Initiative without one.

features.name: Bloodthirst
features.text: When a creature within 30 feet becomes Bloodied, teleport next to it and make a melee attack. Intelligence modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Dread Allegiance
features.text: Choose Bane, Bhaal or Myrkul for a matching damage resistance and an Intelligence-based cantrip; change it after a Long Rest.

features.name: Strike Fear
features.text: New Cunning Strike option (1d6): the target makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened, and you have advantage against it while it is.

features.name: Aura of Malevolence
features.text: When you teleport with Bloodthirst, chosen creatures near your start or end point take damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Cutthroat
features.text: Regain one Bloodthirst use when you finish a Short Rest.

features.name: Murderous Intent
features.text: When you roll Sneak Attack damage, treat any 1 or 2 as a 3.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.text: You have Psionic Energy Dice that fuel this subclass's powers, growing in number and size with level. They return on rests.

features.name: Psi-Bolstered Knack
features.text: When you fail a check with a skill or tool you're proficient in, add a Psionic Energy Die; it's spent only if you then succeed.

features.name: Psychic Whispers
features.text: As a Magic action, telepathically link creatures you can see for hours equal to a Psionic Energy Die roll.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.text: When you attack, manifest a psychic blade from your free hand (1d6 Psychic), and throw a second one as a Bonus Action (1d4).

features.name: Soul Blades
features.text: Homing Strikes: add a die to a missed blade attack. Psychic Teleportation: spend a die as a Bonus Action to throw a blade and teleport where it lands.

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.text: As a Magic action, become Invisible for up to 1 hour, ending if you deal damage or force a save. Once per Long Rest or by spending a die.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.text: When your Psychic Blades deal Sneak Attack damage, the target makes a Wisdom save or is Stunned for 1 minute. Once per Long Rest or 3 dice.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.text: As a Bonus Action, make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools, or use an object as a Utilize action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.text: Gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and your jumps use Dexterity.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.text: New Cunning Strike option (1d6): attacking doesn't end your Invisible condition from hiding if you end your turn behind cover.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.text: Attune to four magic items, sometimes avoid using charges, and use any Spell Scroll with Intelligence.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.text: In the first round of combat, take one turn at your Initiative and another at your Initiative minus 10.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Arms of Hadar, Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Sliver. Level 5: Hunger of Hadar, Sending. Level 7: Evard's Black Tentacles, Summon Aberration. Level 9: Rary's Telepathic Bond, Telekinesis.

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.text: As a Bonus Action, link minds with a creature within 30 feet for minutes equal to your Sorcerer level.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.text: Cast your Psionic Spells by spending Sorcery Points equal to the spell's level instead of a slot, with no Verbal, Somatic or most Material components.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.text: Resistance to Psychic damage and advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed and Frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.text: As a Bonus Action, spend Sorcery Points for 10 minutes of bodily changes: flying, swimming and water breathing, seeing invisible creatures, or squeezing through tight spaces.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.text: As a Magic action, teleport up to 120 feet and pull nearby creatures toward the spot you left, damaging them on a failed Strength save. Once per Long Rest or 5 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Clockwork Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Aid, Alarm, Lesser Restoration, Protection from Evil and Good. Level 5: Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy. Level 7: Freedom of Movement, Summon Construct. Level 9: Greater Restoration, Wall of Force.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.text: As a Reaction, cancel advantage or disadvantage on a d20 roll of a creature within 60 feet. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.text: Spend 1 to 5 Sorcery Points to give yourself or a creature within 30 feet that many d8s to reduce incoming damage.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.text: As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute attacks against you can't have advantage and your d20 rolls of 9 or lower count as 10. Once per Long Rest or 5 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.text: As a Magic action, summon spirits of order in a 30-foot cube that heal up to 100 HP, repair objects and end spells of level 6 or lower. Once per Long Rest or 7 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.text: Your HP maximum increases by 3 plus 1 per later Sorcerer level, and without armor your AC is 10 + Dexterity modifier + Charisma modifier.

features.name: Draconic Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath. Level 5: Fear, Fly. Level 7: Arcane Eye, Charm Monster. Level 9: Legend Lore, Summon Dragon.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.text: Choose a dragon damage type: gain resistance to it and add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of spells that deal it.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.text: As a Bonus Action, sprout wings for 1 hour and gain a 60-foot Fly Speed. Once per Long Rest or 3 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Dragon Companion
features.text: Cast Summon Dragon without material components, once per Long Rest without a slot, optionally without Concentration for 1 minute.

features.name: Shadow Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Bane, Darkness, Inflict Wounds, Pass without Trace. Level 5: Hunger of Hadar, Nondetection. Level 7: Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer. Level 9: Contagion, Creation.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark
features.text: Darkvision 120 feet and Blindsight 10 feet, and you see through Darkness you create.

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.text: When you drop to 0 HP but don't die, make a Charisma save (DC 5 + damage) to have HP equal to Charisma modifier + Sorcerer level instead. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Beasts of Ill Omen
features.text: Spend 3 Sorcery Points as a Bonus Action to summon a shadowy beast without a slot; enemies near it have disadvantage on saves against your spells.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.text: As a Bonus Action while in dim light or darkness, teleport up to 120 feet to another dim or dark space you can see.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.text: While Innate Sorcery is active, take a shadow form: move through creatures and objects and resist most damage. Once per Long Rest or 6 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Spellfire Burst
features.text: Once per turn, when you spend Sorcery Points on a Magic action or Bonus Action, release Bolstering Flames (temp HP) or Radiant Fire (1d4 damage).

features.name: Spellfire Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Scorching Ray. Level 5: Aura of Vitality, Dispel Magic. Level 7: Fire Shield, Wall of Fire. Level 9: Flame Strike, Greater Restoration.

features.name: Absorb Spells
features.text: Counterspell is always prepared, and you regain 1d4 Sorcery Points when a creature fails its save against your Counterspell.

features.name: Honed Spellfire
features.text: Bolstering Flames adds your Sorcerer level to the temp HP, and Radiant Fire becomes 1d8.

features.name: Crown of Spellfire
features.text: Enhance Innate Sorcery once per Long Rest (or 5 Sorcery Points) to gain damage reduction with Hit Dice, a 60-foot Fly Speed with hover, and no damage on successful half-damage saves.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.text: Once per turn after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, roll a d20; on a 20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.text: Give yourself advantage on one d20 Test. It recharges on a Long Rest, or when the GM has you roll on the surge table after casting a Sorcerer spell.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.text: As a Reaction and 1 Sorcery Point, add or subtract 1d4 from another creature's d20 Test.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.text: When you roll on the surge table, roll twice and pick either result.

features.name: Tamed Surge
features.text: Once per Long Rest, after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, choose a surge effect from the table instead of rolling.

features.name: Archfey Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Calm Emotions, Faerie Fire, Misty Step, Phantasmal Force, Sleep. Level 5: Blink, Plant Growth. Level 7: Dominate Beast, Greater Invisibility. Level 9: Dominate Person, Seeming.

features.name: Steps of the Fey
features.text: Cast Misty Step without a slot Charisma modifier times per Long Rest (minimum once), adding a Refreshing Step (temp HP) or Taunting Step (disadvantage) effect.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.text: Cast Misty Step as a Reaction when you take damage, and add Disappearing Step (invisibility) and Dreadful Step (psychic damage nearby) options.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.text: Immune to Charmed. When a creature you see hits you, use your Reaction to halve the damage and force a Wisdom save or it takes psychic damage equal to what you took. Once per Long Rest or by spending a Pact slot.

features.name: Bewitching Magic
features.text: When you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell with an action and a slot, you can also cast Misty Step without a slot.

features.name: Celestial Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Aid, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Light, Sacred Flame. Level 5: Daylight, Revivify. Level 7: Guardian of Faith, Wall of Fire. Level 9: Greater Restoration, Summon Celestial.

features.name: Healing Light
features.text: A pool of d6s equal to 1 + Warlock level. As a Bonus Action, heal yourself or a creature within 60 feet by spending up to your Charisma modifier in dice. Refills on a Long Rest.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.text: Resistance to Radiant damage. Once per turn, add your Charisma modifier to a spell's Radiant or Fire damage against one target.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.text: When you use Magical Cunning or finish a rest, gain temp HP equal to Warlock level + Charisma modifier; up to five creatures gain half.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.text: When you or an ally within 60 feet would make a Death Saving Throw, restore half their HP max instead and blast nearby enemies with Radiant damage, Blinding them. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Fiend Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion. Level 5: Fireball, Stinking Cloud. Level 7: Fire Shield, Wall of Fire. Level 9: Geas, Insect Plague.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.text: When an enemy drops to 0 HP by you or within 10 feet of you, gain temp HP equal to Charisma modifier + Warlock level (minimum 1).

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.text: Add 1d10 to an ability check or save after seeing the roll. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest, at most once per roll.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.text: After a Short or Long Rest, choose one damage type other than Force to resist.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.text: Once per turn when you hit, the target makes a Charisma save or is sent through the Lower Planes, taking psychic damage and becoming Incapacitated until your next turn ends. Once per Long Rest or by spending a Pact slot.

features.name: Great Old One Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Phantasmal Force, Tasha's Hideous Laughter. Level 5: Clairvoyance, Hunger of Hadar. Level 7: Confusion, Summon Aberration. Level 9: Modify Memory, Telekinesis.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.text: As a Bonus Action, form a telepathic link with a creature within 30 feet that lasts for minutes equal to your Warlock level.

features.name: Psychic Spells
features.text: Your Warlock damage spells can deal Psychic damage, and Enchantment or Illusion Warlock spells need no Verbal or Somatic components.

features.name: Clairvoyant Combatant
features.text: When you link with Awakened Mind, the creature makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage attacking you and you have advantage against it. Once per rest or by spending a Pact slot.

features.name: Eldritch Hex
features.text: Hex is always prepared; when you cast it, the target also has disadvantage on saves of the chosen ability.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.text: Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it, you resist Psychic damage, and creatures that deal Psychic damage to you take the same amount.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.text: When you cast Summon Aberration, it needs no Concentration, lasts 1 minute, gains temp HP, and deals extra Psychic damage to targets under your Hex.

features.name: Undead Spells
features.text: Always prepared. Level 3: Bane, Blindness/Deafness, Phantasmal Force, Ray of Sickness. Level 5: Speak with Dead, Summon Undead. Level 7: Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer. Level 9: Antilife Shell, Cloudkill.

features.name: Form of Dread
features.text: As a Bonus Action, transform for 1 minute: gain 1d10 + Warlock level temp HP, immunity to Frightened, and once per turn a hit can frighten the target on a failed Wisdom save. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Arcane Necrosis
features.text: Your Necrotic damage ignores resistance, and once per turn you can change a spell's damage to Necrotic. While transformed, Necrotic hits deal an extra die once per turn.

features.name: Undead Endurance
features.text: You don't need sleep and don't gain Exhaustion from lack of air, food or water.

features.name: Necrotic Resilience
features.text: Resistance to Necrotic damage, immunity while transformed.

features.name: Unholy Resuscitation
features.text: When you drop to 0 HP without dying, burst necrotic energy at nearby creatures and return with HP equal to twice your Warlock level, gaining 1 Exhaustion. Once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Spectral Form
features.text: While transformed, resist Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing, fly and hover at your Speed, move through objects, and cast Conjuration and Necromancy spells without most components.

features.name: Vestige Companion
features.text: Summon a Celestial, Fiend or Undead spirit companion that follows your commands and disappears if you die.

features.name: Vestige Spells
features.text: Choose a Cleric domain (Life, Light, Trickery or War); its domain spells become always-prepared Warlock spells at matching levels.

features.name: Vestige Power
features.text: Your companion regains its divine power on rests and when you use Magical Cunning, and you resist its damage types while near it.

features.name: Vestige Recovery
features.text: Once per Long Rest, when your companion would drop to 0 HP, spend a Reaction and a Pact slot to restore it to full HP and teleport it near you.

features.name: Semblance of Life
features.text: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action, transform your companion into an empowered spirit form for 1 hour, with temp HP equal to its HP.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.text: Add two Abjuration spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free, and one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.text: When you cast an Abjuration spell with a slot, create a ward that absorbs damage. Casting more Abjuration spells or spending a Bonus Action and a slot recharges it. A new ward requires a Long Rest.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.text: As a Reaction, your Arcane Ward can absorb damage dealt to a creature you see within 30 feet.

features.name: Spell Breaker
features.text: Counterspell and Dispel Magic are always prepared; cast Dispel Magic as a Bonus Action adding your Proficiency Bonus, and a failed attempt doesn't spend the slot.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.text: Advantage on saves against spells and resistance to spell damage.

features.name: Bladesong
features.text: As a Bonus Action while wearing no armor or shield, for 1 minute add Intelligence modifier to AC and Concentration saves, gain +10 feet of Speed and advantage on Acrobatics. Limited uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Training in War and Song
features.text: Proficiency with one-handed martial melee weapons and one skill; a melee weapon can be your spellcasting focus.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice when you take the Attack action, and you can replace one attack with a Wizard cantrip that takes an action.

features.name: Song of Defense
features.text: While Bladesong is active, when you take damage spend a Reaction and a slot to reduce it by five times the slot's level.

features.name: Song of Victory
features.text: After casting a spell with an action, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.text: Add two Conjuration spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free, and one more each new spell slot level.

features.name: Benign Transposition
features.text: As a Bonus Action, teleport up to 30 feet or swap places with a willing Medium or smaller creature. Limited uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Distant Transposition
features.text: Benign Transposition reaches 60 feet, and spending a level 3+ slot restores a use.

features.name: Durable Summons
features.text: Creatures you summon with a Conjuration spell gain temp HP equal to twice your Wizard level and resistance to most damage while they have them.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.text: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Conjuration spells.

features.name: Splintered Summons
features.text: When you cast a summoning spell, conjure two copies of the creature, each with half HP. Once per Long Rest or by spending a level 5+ slot.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.text: Add two Divination spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free, and one more each new spell slot level.

features.name: Portent
features.text: After a Long Rest, roll two d20s and record them. Once per turn, replace any D20 Test of a creature you can see with one of those rolls.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.text: When you cast a Divination spell with a level 2+ slot, regain a lower-level spent slot (up to level 5).

features.name: The Third Eye
features.text: As a Bonus Action, gain Darkvision 120 feet, read any language, or see invisible things until your next rest. Once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.text: Roll three d20s for Portent instead of two.

features.name: Enchanting Conversationalist
features.text: Gain proficiency in Deception, Intimidation or Persuasion, and add your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1) to checks with it.

features.name: Enchantment Savant
features.text: Add two Enchantment spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free, and one more each new spell slot level.

features.name: Hypnotic Presence
features.text: As a Magic action, a creature within 10 feet makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed, Incapacitated and has Speed 0. Intelligence modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.text: When you cast an Enchantment spell with a slot, treat it as one level higher to add a target. Intelligence modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Instinctive Charm
features.text: As a Reaction when a creature within 30 feet attacks you, it makes a Wisdom save or the attack misses or is redirected. Recharges on a Long Rest or by casting an Enchantment spell.

features.name: Alter Memories
features.text: Creatures charmed by your Enchantment spells don't realize it, and you can make one erase memories from the spell's duration on a failed Intelligence save.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.text: Add two Evocation spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free, and one more each new spell slot level.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.text: When a creature avoids your damaging cantrip (miss or successful save), it still takes half damage but no other effect.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.text: When you cast an Evocation spell, up to 1 + the spell's level creatures automatically succeed on its saves and take no damage on a success.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.text: Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of a Wizard Evocation spell.

features.name: Overchannel
features.text: Deal maximum damage with a level 1 to 5 Wizard spell. Using it again before a Long Rest deals escalating Necrotic damage to you.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.text: Add two Illusion spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free, and one more each new spell slot level.

features.name: Improved Illusions
features.text: Your Illusion spells need no Verbal components and gain 60 feet of range; you know Minor Illusion, can cast it as a Bonus Action, and it can make both sound and image.

features.name: Phantasmal Creatures
features.text: Summon Beast and Summon Fey are always prepared; once per Long Rest each, cast an illusory version without a slot at half HP.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.text: As a Reaction when a creature attacks you, an illusory duplicate makes the attack miss. Once per Short or Long Rest or by spending a level 2+ slot.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.text: When you cast an Illusion spell with a slot, use a Bonus Action to make one inanimate, nonmagical object in it real for 1 minute.

features.name: Necromancy Savant
features.text: Add two Necromancy spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free, and one more each new spell slot level.

features.name: Necrotic Resistance
features.text: You have resistance to Necrotic damage.

features.name: Undead Familiar
features.text: Find Familiar is in your spellbook with skeleton and zombie forms, and your familiar can attack in place of one of your attacks.

features.name: Undead Vitality
features.text: When you cast a Necromancy spell with a slot, an Undead you see within 60 feet regains HP equal to slot level + Wizard level.

features.name: Grave Power
features.text: While holding your spellbook, Arcane Recovery also removes 1 Exhaustion, and your Wizard spells ignore Necrotic resistance.

features.name: Undead Thralls
features.text: Animate Dead is always prepared and castable once per Long Rest without a slot as one level higher; your undead gain extra HP and Necrotic damage.

features.name: Harvest Undead
features.text: When you become Bloodied, use a Reaction to destroy one of your undead and regain HP equal to your Wizard level.

features.name: Death's Master
features.text: Once per Long Rest give your undead temp HP as a Bonus Action, and your undead explode in Necrotic damage when destroyed.

features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.text: Add two Transmutation spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free, and one more each new spell slot level.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.text: After a Long Rest, craft a stone that acts as a focus and grants Constitution save proficiency plus Darkvision, a resistance, or +10 feet of Speed to its bearer.

features.name: Wondrous Alteration
features.text: Alter Self is always prepared and castable once per Long Rest without a slot, with extra benefits for each of its options.

features.name: Empowered Transmutation
features.text: Cast certain Transmutation spells as if one level higher, a limited number of times per Long Rest.

features.name: Potent Stone
features.text: Your stone can hold two benefits and gains Mighty Build and Tremorsense options; swap them when you cast Transmutation spells.

features.name: Shape-Shifter
features.text: Polymorph is always prepared and castable once per Long Rest without a slot; targeting yourself keeps your mind and some spellcasting.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.text: Consume your stone for a major effect: Major Transformation, Panacea, Restore Life or Restore Youth.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.text: Resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.text: As a Magic action, touch a creature to heal it a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.text: You know the Light cantrip (Charisma).

traits.name: Celestial Revelation
traits.text: From level 3, as a Bonus Action transform for 1 minute: Heavenly Wings (fly), Inner Radiance (radiant aura) or Necrotic Shroud (frighten); once per turn add damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.text: Choose a dragon type; it sets your breath weapon and resistance damage type.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: Replace one attack with a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line: Dexterity save, 1d10 damage (2d10 at 5th, 3d10 at 11th, 4d10 at 17th). Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.text: Resistance to your ancestry's damage type.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.text: From level 5, as a Bonus Action sprout wings for 10 minutes and gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.text: Resistance to Poison damage and advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.text: Your HP maximum increases by 1 per level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.text: As a Bonus Action, gain Tremorsense 60 feet for 10 minutes while on stone. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

traits.name: Drow Lineage
traits.text: Darkvision 120 feet and the Dancing Lights cantrip; Faerie Fire at level 3 and Darkness at level 5, each once per Long Rest without a slot.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Proficiency in Insight, Perception or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.text: You don't need sleep; a Long Rest takes 4 hours of trance.

traits.name: High Elf Lineage
traits.text: Prestidigitation (swap it after a Long Rest); Detect Magic at level 3 and Misty Step at level 5, each once per Long Rest without a slot.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Proficiency in Insight, Perception or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.text: You don't need sleep; a Long Rest takes 4 hours of trance.

traits.name: Wood Elf Lineage
traits.text: Speed 35 feet and the Druidcraft cantrip; Longstrider at level 3 and Pass without Trace at level 5, each once per Long Rest without a slot.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Proficiency in Insight, Perception or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.text: You don't need sleep; a Long Rest takes 4 hours of trance.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.text: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Forest Gnome Lineage
traits.text: You know Minor Illusion and always have Speak with Animals prepared, castable without a slot Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.text: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Rock Gnome Lineage
traits.text: You know Mending and Prestidigitation, and can spend 10 minutes to make a Tiny clockwork device with a simple effect.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.text: Choose a boon used Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest: Cloud's Jaunt (teleport), Fire's Burn (fire damage), Frost's Chill (cold and slow), Hill's Tumble (knock prone), Stone's Endurance (reduce damage) or Storm's Thunder (thunder reaction).

traits.name: Large Form
traits.text: From level 5, as a Bonus Action become Large for 10 minutes: advantage on Strength checks and +10 feet of Speed. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.text: Advantage to end Grappled, and you count as one size larger for carrying capacity.

traits.name: Brave
traits.text: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Frightened.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.text: You can move through the space of any creature larger than you.

traits.name: Luck
traits.text: When you roll a 1 on a d20 Test, you can reroll it and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.text: You can Hide behind a creature at least one size larger than you.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.text: You gain Heroic Inspiration when you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.text: Proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.text: You gain an Origin feat of your choice (Skilled is recommended).

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
