traits.text: Take the Dash action as a Bonus Action and gain temp HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Proficiency Bonus uses per Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.text: When you drop to 0 HP but don't die, drop to 1 HP instead. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Abyssal Legacy
traits.text: Resistance to Poison and the Poison Spray cantrip; Ray of Sickness at level 3 and Hold Person at level 5, once per Long Rest each.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.text: You know Thaumaturgy.

traits.name: Chthonic Legacy
traits.text: Resistance to Necrotic and the Chill Touch cantrip; False Life at level 3 and Ray of Enfeeblement at level 5, once per Long Rest each.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.text: You know Thaumaturgy.

traits.name: Infernal Legacy
traits.text: Resistance to Fire and the Fire Bolt cantrip; Hellish Rebuke at level 3 and Darkness at level 5, once per Long Rest each.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.text: You know Thaumaturgy.

feats.name: Alert
feats.text: Add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative (add it in Editar > Ajustes > Bonus initiative), and you can swap your Initiative with a willing ally at the start of combat.

feats.name: Crafter
feats.text: Proficiency with three Artisan's Tools, a 20% discount on nonmagical items, and you can craft simple items during a Long Rest.

feats.name: Healer
feats.text: Spend a use of a Healer's Kit to let a creature spend a Hit Die and heal, adding your Proficiency Bonus; reroll 1s on healing dice.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.text: Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest: give yourself advantage on a d20 Test or impose disadvantage on an attack against you.

feats.name: Magic Initiate
feats.text: Choose Cleric, Druid or Wizard: learn two cantrips and a level 1 spell from that list, castable once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots).

feats.name: Musician
feats.text: Proficiency with three musical instruments, and after a rest you can give Heroic Inspiration to allies equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

feats.name: Savage Attacker
feats.text: Once per turn, roll a weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll.

feats.name: Skilled
feats.text: Proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

feats.name: Tavern Brawler
feats.text: Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 + Strength, reroll 1s on their damage, proficiency with improvised weapons, and push a creature 5 feet on a hit once per turn.

feats.name: Tough
feats.text: Your HP maximum increases by twice your level, and by 2 more each level.

feats.name: Actor
feats.text: Advantage on Deception and Performance checks to pass as someone else, and you can mimic voices.

feats.name: Athlete
feats.text: Gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, stand up from Prone with 5 feet of movement, and make running jumps after moving only 5 feet.

feats.name: Charger
feats.text: Dash adds 10 feet of Speed; after moving 10 feet in a straight line, a melee hit deals 1d8 extra or pushes 10 feet, once per turn.

feats.name: Chef
feats.text: Proficiency with Cook's Utensils; cook food that gives extra healing on Short Rests and treats that grant temp HP.

feats.name: Crossbow Expert
feats.text: Ignore Loading on crossbows, no disadvantage firing in melee, and add your ability modifier to the Light extra attack damage.

feats.name: Crusher
feats.text: Once per turn, Bludgeoning hits push 5 feet, and critical hits give allies advantage against the target.

feats.name: Defensive Duelist
feats.text: While holding a Finesse weapon, use your Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to AC against a melee attack.

feats.name: Dual Wielder
feats.text: When you attack with a Light weapon, make a Bonus Action attack with a non-Two-Handed weapon, and draw or stow two weapons at once.

feats.name: Durable
feats.text: Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and as a Bonus Action spend a Hit Die to heal.

feats.name: Elemental Adept
feats.text: Your spells ignore resistance to a chosen element, and damage dice of 1 count as 2.

feats.name: Fey Touched
feats.text: Learn Misty Step and a level 1 Divination or Enchantment spell; cast each once per Long Rest without a slot.

feats.name: Grappler
feats.text: Grapple as part of an Unarmed Strike, advantage on attacks against creatures you grapple, and move them without extra cost.

feats.name: Great Weapon Master
feats.text: Heavy weapon hits deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and a critical or a kill grants a Bonus Action attack.

feats.name: Heavily Armored
feats.text: Gain training with Heavy armor.

feats.name: Heavy Armor Master
feats.text: While wearing Heavy armor, reduce Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage by your Proficiency Bonus.

feats.name: Inspiring Leader
feats.text: After a rest, give up to six allies temp HP equal to your level + the ability modifier.

feats.name: Keen Mind
feats.text: Proficiency or Expertise in a knowledge skill, and you can take the Study action as a Bonus Action.

feats.name: Lightly Armored
feats.text: Gain training with Light armor and Shields.

feats.name: Mage Slayer
feats.text: Your hits impose disadvantage on concentration saves, and once per Long Rest turn a failed mental save into a success.

feats.name: Martial Weapon Training
feats.text: Proficiency with Martial weapons.

feats.name: Medium Armor Master
feats.text: Medium armor lets you add up to +3 Dexterity to AC.

feats.name: Moderately Armored
feats.text: Gain training with Medium armor.

feats.name: Mounted Combatant
feats.text: Advantage against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount, redirect attacks to you, and your mount gets Evasion.

feats.name: Observant
feats.text: Proficiency or Expertise in Insight, Investigation or Perception, and you can Search as a Bonus Action.

feats.name: Piercer
feats.text: Once per turn reroll one Piercing damage die, and critical hits with Piercing damage add an extra die.

feats.name: Poisoner
feats.text: Your poison damage ignores resistance, and you can brew poisons that deal 2d8 and poison on a failed save.

feats.name: Polearm Master
feats.text: Make a Bonus Action attack with the butt of a Quarterstaff, Spear or Heavy Reach weapon, and creatures entering your reach provoke an attack.

feats.name: Resilient
feats.text: Gain proficiency in saving throws of the ability you increase.

feats.name: Ritual Caster
feats.text: Learn level 1 Ritual spells equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and cast one quickly once per Long Rest.

feats.name: Sentinel
feats.text: Opportunity attacks reduce Speed to 0, creatures that Disengage still provoke, and you can attack those who attack your allies.

feats.name: Shadow Touched
feats.text: Learn Invisibility and a level 1 Illusion or Necromancy spell; cast each once per Long Rest without a slot.

feats.name: Sharpshooter
feats.text: Ranged attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover, no disadvantage in melee or at long range.

feats.name: Shield Master
feats.text: Shield bash to push or knock Prone after a hit, and use your Reaction to take no damage on a successful Dexterity save.

feats.name: Skill Expert
feats.text: Gain proficiency in one skill and Expertise in another.

feats.name: Skulker
feats.text: Blindsight 10 feet, Hide in lightly obscured areas, and missing an attack doesn't reveal you.

feats.name: Slasher
feats.text: Once per turn a Slashing hit reduces the target's Speed by 10 feet, and critical hits impose disadvantage on its attacks.

feats.name: Speedy
feats.text: Your Speed increases by 10 feet, Dash ignores difficult terrain, and opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

feats.name: Spell Sniper
feats.text: Spell attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover, no disadvantage in melee, and attack spells gain 60 feet of range.

feats.name: Telekinetic
feats.text: Learn an invisible Mage Hand, and as a Bonus Action shove a creature 5 feet on a failed Strength save.

feats.name: Telepathic
feats.text: Telepathy 60 feet, and cast Detect Thoughts once per Long Rest without a slot.

feats.name: War Caster
feats.text: Advantage on concentration saves, perform somatic components with full hands, and cast a spell as an opportunity attack.

feats.name: Weapon Master
feats.text: Use the mastery property of one weapon kind, changeable after a Long Rest.

feats.name: Archery
feats.text: +2 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

feats.name: Blind Fighting
feats.text: Blindsight 10 feet.

feats.name: Defense
feats.text: +1 AC while wearing Light, Medium or Heavy armor. Add it in Editar > Ajustes > Bonus AC.

feats.name: Dueling
feats.text: +2 damage with a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapon.

feats.name: Great Weapon Fighting
feats.text: Treat 1s and 2s on damage dice of two-handed or versatile melee weapons as 3s.

feats.name: Interception
feats.text: As a Reaction, reduce damage to a nearby ally by 1d10 + your Proficiency Bonus.

feats.name: Protection
feats.text: With a Shield, use your Reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack against a nearby ally and give it resistance.

feats.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
feats.text: Draw thrown weapons as part of the attack, and +2 damage with them.

feats.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
feats.text: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the extra Light weapon attack.

feats.name: Unarmed Fighting
feats.text: Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 (1d8 with both hands free) + Strength, and you damage creatures you grapple.

feats.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
feats.text: Once per turn, turn a missed attack into a hit.

feats.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
feats.text: After you take the Attack or Magic action, teleport up to 30 feet.

feats.name: Boon of Energy Resistance
feats.text: Resistance to two damage types, and redirect damage of those types to another creature with your Reaction.

feats.name: Boon of Fate
feats.text: When a creature fails or succeeds on a d20 Test, add or subtract 2d4. Once per Initiative or rest.

feats.name: Boon of Fortitude
feats.text: Your HP maximum increases by 40, and healing gives you extra HP equal to your Constitution modifier once per turn.

feats.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
feats.text: Your Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage ignores resistance, and a natural 20 adds damage equal to the ability score you raised.

feats.name: Boon of Recovery
feats.text: Once per Long Rest, drop to 1 HP instead of 0 and regain half your HP, and a pool of ten d10s to heal as a Bonus Action.

feats.name: Boon of Skill
feats.text: Proficiency in all skills and Expertise in one.

feats.name: Boon of Speed
feats.text: Your Speed increases by 30 feet, and you can Disengage as a Bonus Action.

feats.name: Boon of Spell Recall
feats.text: Once per Long Rest, cast a level 1 to 4 spell without expending a slot.

feats.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
feats.text: In dim light or darkness, become Invisible as a Bonus Action and resist all damage except Psychic and Radiant.

feats.name: Boon of Truesight
feats.text: You have Truesight out to 60 feet.

invocations.name: Agonizing Blast
invocations.prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock, a Warlock cantrip that deals damage
invocations.text: Choose a damaging Warlock cantrip: add your Charisma modifier to its damage rolls. Repeatable for a different cantrip.

invocations.name: Armor of Shadows
invocations.text: Cast Mage Armor on yourself without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Ascendant Step
invocations.text: Cast Levitate on yourself without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Devil's Sight
invocations.text: You see normally in magical and nonmagical darkness within 120 feet.

invocations.name: Devouring Blade
invocations.text: Thirsting Blade gives you two extra attacks instead of one.

invocations.name: Eldritch Mind
invocations.text: Advantage on Constitution saves to maintain Concentration.

invocations.name: Eldritch Smite
invocations.prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock, Pact of the Blade
invocations.text: Once per turn when you hit with your pact weapon, spend a Pact Magic slot for extra Force damage and possibly knock the target Prone.

invocations.name: Eldritch Spear
invocations.prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock, a damaging Warlock cantrip with range 10+ feet
invocations.text: One chosen cantrip's range increases by 30 feet times your Warlock level.

invocations.name: Fiendish Vigor
invocations.text: Cast False Life on yourself without a slot, getting the maximum temp HP.

invocations.name: Gaze of Two Minds
invocations.text: Touch a willing creature to perceive through its senses, keep the link with Bonus Actions, and cast spells as if from its space.

invocations.name: Gift of the Depths
invocations.text: Breathe underwater and gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed; cast Water Breathing once per Long Rest without a slot.

invocations.name: Gift of the Protectors
invocations.prerequisite: Level 9+ Warlock, Pact of the Tome
invocations.text: Creatures who wrote their names in your Book of Shadows drop to 1 HP instead of 0, once each per Long Rest.

invocations.name: Investment of the Chain Master
invocations.prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock, Pact of the Chain
invocations.text: Your familiar gains a fly or swim speed, attacks with a Bonus Action command, uses your spell save DC, and you can give it resistance.

invocations.name: Lessons of the First Ones
invocations.text: Gain an Origin feat of your choice.

invocations.name: Lifedrinker
invocations.prerequisite: Level 9+ Warlock, Pact of the Blade
invocations.text: Once per turn, your pact weapon hits deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic, Psychic or Radiant damage and you can spend a Hit Die to heal.

invocations.name: Mask of Many Faces
invocations.text: Cast Disguise Self without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Master of Myriad Forms
invocations.text: Cast Alter Self without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Misty Visions
invocations.text: Cast Silent Image without a spell slot.

invocations.name: One with Shadows
invocations.text: While in dim light or darkness, cast Invisibility on yourself without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Otherworldly Leap
invocations.text: Cast Jump on yourself without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Pact of the Blade
invocations.text: As a Bonus Action, conjure a pact weapon or bond with a magic weapon; you're proficient, can use Charisma for attack and damage, and can deal Necrotic, Psychic or Radiant damage.

invocations.name: Pact of the Chain
invocations.text: Find Familiar is always prepared and castable without a slot, with special forms (imp, pseudodragon, quasit, sprite and more), and your familiar can attack with its Reaction.

invocations.name: Pact of the Tome
invocations.text: Conjure a Book of Shadows with three cantrips and two level 1 Ritual spells always prepared; it is a spellcasting focus.

invocations.name: Repelling Blast
invocations.prerequisite: Level 2+ Warlock, a damaging Warlock cantrip with an attack roll
invocations.text: When that cantrip hits a Large or smaller creature, push it up to 10 feet.

invocations.name: Thirsting Blade
invocations.prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock, Pact of the Blade
invocations.text: You can attack twice with your pact weapon when you take the Attack action.

invocations.name: Visions of Distant Realms
invocations.text: Cast Arcane Eye without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Whispers of the Grave
invocations.text: Cast Speak with Dead without a spell slot.

invocations.name: Witch Sight
invocations.text: You have Truesight out to 30 feet.

items.name: Acid (vial)
items.text: Throw it (ranged attack, 20 ft): 2d6 acid damage on a hit.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
items.text: Throw it (20 ft): the target takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of each turn until it uses an action to put it out.

items.name: Antitoxin (vial)
items.text: Advantage on saves against poison for 1 hour.

items.name: Backpack
items.text: Holds 1 cubic foot or 30 lb of gear.

items.name: Ball Bearings (bag of 1,000)
items.text: Cover a 10-foot square; creatures moving through must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity save or fall prone.

items.name: Block and Tackle
items.text: Lets you hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.

items.name: Caltrops (bag of 20)
items.text: Cover a 5-foot square; creatures entering must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity save or take 1 piercing damage and lose speed.

items.name: Candle
items.text: Bright light in 5 ft for 1 hour.

items.name: Case, Crossbow Bolt
items.text: Holds up to 20 bolts.

items.name: Climber's Kit
items.text: Anchor yourself: you can't fall more than 25 feet from the anchor point.

items.name: Component Pouch
items.text: Holds the material components for your spells that have no cost.

items.name: Crowbar
items.text: Advantage on Strength checks where leverage helps.

items.name: Healer's Kit
items.text: Ten uses. Stabilize a creature at 0 HP without a Medicine check.

items.name: Holy Water (flask)
items.text: Throw it (20 ft): 2d6 radiant damage to a fiend or undead on a hit.

items.name: Hunting Trap
items.text: A creature that steps in makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or takes 1d4 piercing damage and is stuck.

items.name: Lamp
items.text: Bright light 15 ft and dim light 30 ft for 6 hours per flask of oil.

items.name: Lantern, Bullseye
items.text: Bright light in a 60-foot cone and dim light 60 more feet.

items.name: Lantern, Hooded
items.text: Bright light 30 ft and dim light 30 more feet; can be lowered to dim light 5 ft.

items.name: Oil (flask)
items.text: Can be thrown and set alight to burn for 5 fire damage.

items.name: Poison, Basic (vial)
items.text: Coat a weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition: 1d4 poison damage on a hit (DC 10 Constitution save).

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.text: Regain 2d4 + 2 hit points.

items.name: Quiver
items.text: Holds up to 20 arrows.

items.name: Ram, Portable
items.text: +4 to Strength checks to break doors.

items.name: Torch
items.text: Bright light 20 ft and dim light 20 more feet for 1 hour.

items.name: Net
items.text: Throw it at a Large or smaller creature (range 5/15): it is restrained until freed (DC 10 Strength check or 5 slashing damage to the net).

items.name: Firearm Bullets (10)
items.text: Ammunition for pistols and muskets.

items.name: Burglar's Pack
items.text: Backpack, ball bearings, string, bell, candles, crowbar, hammer, pitons, hooded lantern, oil, rations, tinderbox, waterskin and rope.

items.name: Diplomat's Pack
items.text: Chest, map cases, fine clothes, ink, pen, lamp, oil, paper, perfume, sealing wax and soap.

items.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
items.text: Backpack, crowbar, hammer, pitons, torches, tinderbox, rations, waterskin and rope.

items.name: Entertainer's Pack
items.text: Backpack, bedroll, costumes, candles, rations, waterskin and a disguise kit.

items.name: Explorer's Pack
items.text: Backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, torches, rations, waterskin and rope.

items.name: Priest's Pack
items.text: Backpack, blanket, candles, tinderbox, alms box, incense, censer, vestments, rations and waterskin.

items.name: Scholar's Pack
items.text: Backpack, book of lore, ink, pen, parchment, sand and a small knife.

options.name: Ambush
options.text: Add a Superiority Die to a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an Initiative roll.

options.name: Bait and Switch
options.text: Swap places with an ally within 5 feet; one of you adds the die to AC until your next turn starts.

options.name: Commander's Strike
options.text: Give up one attack and a Bonus Action so an ally can use its Reaction to attack, adding the die to damage.

options.name: Commanding Presence
options.text: Add the die to an Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion check.

options.name: Disarming Attack
options.text: Add the die to damage; the target makes a Strength save or drops an object it holds.

options.name: Distracting Strike
options.text: Add the die to damage; the next attack by someone else against the target has advantage.

options.name: Evasive Footwork
options.text: As a Bonus Action, Disengage and add the die to your AC until your next turn starts.

options.name: Feinting Attack
options.text: As a Bonus Action, gain advantage on your next attack against a creature within 5 feet and add the die to its damage.

options.name: Goading Attack
options.text: Add the die to damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage attacking anyone but you.

options.name: Lunging Attack
options.text: As a Bonus Action, Dash; if you then hit with a melee attack, add the die to damage.

options.name: Maneuvering Attack
options.text: Add the die to damage; an ally can use its Reaction to move half its Speed without provoking from the target.

options.name: Menacing Attack
options.text: Add the die to damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened until your next turn ends.

options.name: Parry
options.text: When hit by a melee attack, use your Reaction to reduce the damage by the die + your Strength or Dexterity modifier.

options.name: Precision Attack
options.text: When you miss, add the die to the attack roll, possibly turning it into a hit.

options.name: Pushing Attack
options.text: Add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or is pushed 15 feet.

options.name: Rally
options.text: As a Bonus Action, an ally within 30 feet gains temp HP equal to the die + half your Fighter level.

options.name: Riposte
options.text: When a creature misses you in melee, use your Reaction to attack it, adding the die to damage.

options.name: Sweeping Attack
options.text: When you hit, another creature within 5 feet of you and the target takes the die as damage if your roll would hit it.

options.name: Tactical Assessment
options.text: Add the die to a History, Insight or Investigation check.

options.name: Trip Attack
options.text: Add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or has the Prone condition.

options.name: Careful Spell
options.text: 1 point: up to Charisma modifier creatures automatically succeed on the save and take no damage on a success.

options.name: Distant Spell
options.text: 1 point: increase the range by 60 feet, or make a touch spell reach 30 feet.

options.name: Empowered Spell
options.text: 1 point: reroll up to Charisma modifier damage dice. Can combine with another option.

options.name: Extended Spell
options.text: 1 point: double a duration of 1 minute or longer (up to 24 hours) and gain advantage on Concentration saves for it.

options.name: Heightened Spell
options.text: 2 points: one target has disadvantage on saves against the spell.

options.name: Quickened Spell
options.text: 2 points: cast an action spell as a Bonus Action, but not if you've already cast a level 1+ spell this turn.

options.name: Seeking Spell
options.text: 1 point: reroll a missed spell attack. Can combine with another option.

options.name: Subtle Spell
options.text: 1 point: cast without Verbal, Somatic or Material components (except costly ones).

options.name: Transmuted Spell
options.text: 1 point: change the damage type to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison or Thunder.

options.name: Twinned Spell
options.text: 1 point: when a spell cast with a slot can target more creatures at a higher level, add one more target.

options.name: Colossus Slayer
options.text: Once per turn, a weapon hit on a creature missing HP deals an extra 1d8.

options.name: Horde Breaker
options.text: Once per turn, make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 feet of the first.

options.name: Escape the Horde
options.text: Opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

options.name: Multiattack Defense
options.text: After a creature hits you, its other attacks this turn have disadvantage.

options.name: Protector
options.text: Training with Martial weapons and Heavy armor.

options.name: Thaumaturge
options.text: One extra Cleric cantrip, and add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks.

options.name: Divine Strike
options.text: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage.

options.name: Potent Spellcasting
options.text: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of Cleric cantrips.

options.name: Magician
options.text: One extra Druid cantrip, and add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to Intelligence (Arcana or Nature) checks.

options.name: Warden
options.text: Training with Martial weapons and Medium armor.

options.name: Potent Spellcasting
options.text: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of Druid cantrips.

options.name: Primal Strike
options.text: Once per turn, a weapon or Wild Shape hit deals an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage.

options.name: Owl
options.text: Darkvision 60 feet, or +60 feet if you already have it.

options.name: Panther
options.text: A Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

options.name: Salmon
options.text: A Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.text: An acid bubble bursts in a 5-foot-radius Sphere at a point you choose. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 Acid damage.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11 and 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Blade Ward
spells.text: Until the spell ends, any creature making an attack roll against you subtracts 1d4 from the roll.

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.text: Melee spell attack for 1d10 Necrotic damage. On a hit, the target can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at 11 and 4d10 at 17.

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.text: Create up to four torch-like lights (or one Medium glowing humanoid form), each shedding Dim Light in a 10-foot radius. As a Bonus Action you can move them up to 60 feet; they must stay within 20 feet of each other and within range.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.text: Minor nature effects: predict the weather for 24 hours, make a flower bloom or a seed open, create a harmless sensory effect in a 5-foot cube, or light or snuff a small flame.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.text: A beam of crackling energy: ranged spell attack for 1d10 Force damage.
spells.higher: Two beams at level 5, three at 11 and four at 17. Each beam can target the same or different creatures, with a separate attack roll.

spells.name: Elementalism
spells.text: Small elemental effects: stir air in a 5-foot cube, create a puff of harmless dust or a mote of fire, make a thimble of water or mist, or shape loose earth or stone into a crude figure for 1 hour.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit that isn't worn or carried starts burning.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at 11 and 4d10 at 17.

spells.name: Friends
spells.text: One creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed by you. It succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you are fighting it, or if you cast this on it in the last 24 hours. The spell ends early if the target takes damage or you make an attack roll, deal damage or force a save; the target then knows it was charmed.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.text: Choose a skill. A willing creature adds 1d4 to any ability check using that skill until the spell ends.

spells.name: Light
spells.text: An object no larger than 10 feet sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for 20 more feet, in a color you choose. Covering it blocks the light. Casting it again ends the previous one.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.text: A spectral hand appears. As a Magic action you can use it to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, or stow or retrieve an item; it can carry up to 10 pounds and move 30 feet each time. It can't attack, activate magic items or carry more than 10 pounds.

spells.name: Mending
spells.text: Repairs a single break or tear in an object no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, such as a broken chain link or a torn cloak. It can physically repair a magic item but can't restore its magic.

spells.name: Message
spells.text: Whisper a message to a creature in range; only it hears, and it can reply in a whisper only you hear. You can cast through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence, 1 foot of stone or metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it.

spells.name: Mind Sliver
spells.text: The target makes an Intelligence save or takes 1d6 Psychic damage and subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw before the end of your next turn.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11 and 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.text: Create a sound or an image of an object no larger than a 5-foot cube. Physical interaction reveals an image as illusion. A creature that takes a Study action can make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to see through it.

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 1d12 Poison damage.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d12 at level 5, 3d12 at 11 and 4d12 at 17.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.text: Minor tricks: a harmless sensory effect, light or snuff a small flame, clean or soil a small object, chill, warm or flavor material, make a small mark or symbol appear for 1 hour, or create a trinket or illusory image that fits in your hand until your next turn. Up to three non-instantaneous effects at once.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.text: A flame in your hand sheds Bright Light in 20 feet and Dim Light 20 feet more. Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to hurl it: ranged spell attack within 60 feet for 1d8 Fire damage, which ends the spell.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11 and 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 Cold damage, and the target's Speed drops by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11 and 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Resistance
spells.text: Choose a damage type: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing or Thunder. Once per turn, when the willing target takes that damage, it reduces the total by 1d4.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.text: Radiance descends on a creature you can see. It makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 Radiant damage; it gains no benefit from Half or Three-Quarters Cover for this save.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11 and 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Shillelagh
spells.text: A Club or Quarterstaff you hold uses your spellcasting ability for attack and damage rolls, its damage die becomes a d8, and it can deal Force damage instead of Bludgeoning. The spell ends if you cast it again or let go of the weapon.
spells.higher: Damage die becomes d10 at level 5, d12 at 11 and 2d6 at 17.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
spells.text: Melee spell attack for 1d8 Lightning damage. On a hit, the target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11 and 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Sorcerous Burst
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 damage of a type you choose: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Psychic or Thunder. Each 8 rolled lets you roll another d8 and add it, up to a number of extra d8s equal to your spellcasting modifier.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11 and 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.text: A creature at 0 Hit Points becomes Stable.
spells.higher: Range doubles at level 5 (30 feet), 11 (60 feet) and 17 (120 feet).

spells.name: Starry Wisp
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 Radiant damage. Until the end of your next turn, the target sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11 and 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.text: Minor wonders: your voice booms three times louder, flames flicker or change color, harmless tremors, an instantaneous sound, an unlocked door or window flies open or slams shut, or your eyes change. Up to three 1-minute effects at once.

spells.name: Thorn Whip
spells.text: Melee spell attack for 1d6 Piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, you can pull it up to 10 feet closer to you.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11 and 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Thunderclap
spells.text: Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation from you makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 Thunder damage. The sound is audible up to 100 feet away.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11 and 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Toll the Dead
spells.text: The target makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d8 Necrotic damage, or 1d12 if it is missing any Hit Points.
spells.higher: Damage dice rise to 2 at level 5, 3 at 11 and 4 at 17.

spells.name: True Strike
spells.text: Make one attack with the weapon used as the material component, using your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of Strength or Dexterity. The damage can be Radiant or the weapon's normal type.
spells.higher: Extra 1d6 Radiant damage on a hit at level 5, 2d6 at 11 and 3d6 at 17.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.text: A creature that can hear you makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d6 Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11 and 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Word of Radiance
spells.text: Each creature you choose in a 5-foot Emanation makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 Radiant damage.
spells.higher: Damage rises to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11 and 4d6 at 17.

spells.name: Alarm
spells.text: Ward a door, window or area up to a 20-foot Cube. When a creature touches or enters it, you get a mental ping (wakes you if asleep) or an audible bell for 10 seconds. You choose creatures that don't trigger it.

spells.name: Animal Friendship
spells.text: A Beast you can see makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed by you for the duration. The spell ends if you or your allies damage it.
spells.higher: One additional Beast per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Armor of Agathys
spells.text: You gain 5 Temporary Hit Points. While you have them, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 Cold damage.
spells.higher: Temporary Hit Points and Cold damage both increase by 5 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Arms of Hadar
spells.text: Tendrils erupt in a 10-foot Emanation. Each creature there makes a Strength save or takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn; half damage on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Bane
spells.text: Up to three creatures make a Charisma save. Each that fails subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls and saving throws for the duration.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Bless
spells.text: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to their attack rolls and saving throws for the duration. Material: a Holy Symbol worth 5+ GP.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.text: Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Unattended flammable objects in the Cone start burning.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Buzzing Bee
spells.text: A conjured bee pesters one creature you can see. Until the spell ends it has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks, Dexterity (Stealth) checks and Constitution saves to keep Concentration, and it can't benefit from the Invisible condition.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.text: A Humanoid makes a Wisdom save (with Advantage if you or allies are fighting it) or is Charmed by you. It ends if you or allies damage it. The creature knows it was charmed when the spell ends.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 3d8 damage of a type you choose: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison or Thunder. If two or more d8s show the same number, the orb leaps to another target within 30 feet (new attack); it can leap a number of times equal to the slot level. Material: a diamond worth 50+ GP.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Color Spray
spells.text: Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Constitution save or is Blinded until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Command
spells.text: Speak a one-word command to a creature that understands you: Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel or Halt. On a failed Wisdom save it follows the command on its next turn.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Compelled Duel
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you, and can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from you. Ends if you attack another creature, an ally damages it, or you end your turn more than 30 feet away.

spells.name: Comprehend Languages
spells.text: You understand the literal meaning of any language you hear or sign you see, and any written language you touch. It doesn't decode symbols or secret messages.

spells.name: Create or Destroy Water
spells.text: Create up to 10 gallons of clean water (or rain in a 30-foot Cube that extinguishes exposed flames), or destroy up to 10 gallons of water (or fog in a 30-foot Cube).
spells.higher: 10 more gallons, or 5 feet more on the Cube, per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.text: A creature you touch regains 2d8 + your spellcasting modifier Hit Points.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 2d8 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Detect Evil and Good
spells.text: You sense the location and type of any Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend or Undead within 30 feet, and places or objects consecrated or desecrated. Blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt or wood, 1 inch of metal or a thin sheet of lead.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.text: You sense magic within 30 feet. As a Magic action you can see a faint aura around any visible creature or object bearing magic and learn its school, if any. Blocked by the same barriers as Detect Evil and Good.

spells.name: Detect Poison and Disease
spells.text: You sense the location of poisons, poisonous or venomous creatures, and magical contagions within 30 feet, and learn their kind.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.text: Change how you look, including clothing and gear, up to 1 foot taller or shorter. A creature that takes the Study action can make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to notice.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 3d6 Psychic damage and must use its Reaction, if available, to move as far away from you as it can. On a success it takes half damage only.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Divine Favor
spells.text: Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit for the duration.

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.text: Cast right after you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike: the target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage, plus 1d8 if it is a Fiend or Undead.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Ensnaring Strike
spells.text: Cast right after hitting with a weapon: the target makes a Strength save (Advantage if Large or bigger) or is Restrained by thorny vines and takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. It or a creature within reach can take an action for a Strength (Athletics) check against your DC to free it.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.text: Vines fill a 20-foot square, making it Difficult Terrain. Each creature there when it appears makes a Strength save or is Restrained; it can take an action for a Strength (Athletics) check against your DC to break free.

spells.name: Expeditious Retreat
spells.text: You take the Dash action when you cast it and can Dash as a Bonus Action for the duration.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.text: Each creature in a 20-foot Cube makes a Dexterity save or is outlined in light (blue, green or violet). Attack rolls against outlined creatures have Advantage and they can't benefit from the Invisible condition.

spells.name: False Life
spells.text: You gain 2d4 + 4 Temporary Hit Points.
spells.higher: 5 more Temporary Hit Points per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.text: When you or a creature within 60 feet falls, up to five falling creatures descend at 60 feet per round and take no falling damage.

spells.name: Feign Interest
spells.text: You look attentive and engaged while your mind wanders. A creature that takes the Search action on you can see through it with a Wisdom (Insight) check against your spell save DC.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.text: Summon a spirit familiar (Celestial, Fey or Fiend) in the form of a small animal such as a cat, owl, raven or bat. It acts on its own, shares telepathy within 100 feet, can deliver your touch spells, and you can see through its senses. Material: incense worth 10+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog makes the area Heavily Obscured. A strong wind disperses it.
spells.higher: Radius increases by 20 feet per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Goodberry
spells.text: Ten berries appear. A creature can eat one as a Bonus Action to regain 1 Hit Point; a berry also provides a day of nourishment.

spells.name: Grease
spells.text: A 10-foot square becomes Difficult Terrain. Each creature there when it appears, entering it or ending its turn there makes a Dexterity save or falls Prone.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 4d6 Radiant damage, and the next attack roll against the target before the end of your next turn has Advantage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Hail of Thorns
spells.text: Cast right after hitting with a ranged weapon: the target and each creature within 5 feet of it make a Dexterity save, taking 1d10 Piercing damage on a failure or half on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.text: A creature you can see regains 2d4 + your spellcasting modifier Hit Points.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 2d4 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.text: When a creature you can see damages you, it makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.text: A willing creature is immune to Frightened and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your spellcasting modifier at the start of each of its turns.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Hex
spells.text: Curse a creature: your attacks deal it an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage on a hit, and it has Disadvantage on ability checks with one ability you choose. If it drops to 0 HP, you can move the curse to another creature as a Bonus Action on a later turn.
spells.higher: Duration: up to 4 hours with a level 2 slot, 8 hours with level 3-4, 24 hours with level 5+.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.text: Mark a creature: your attacks deal it an extra 1d6 Force damage on a hit, and you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception or Survival) checks to find it. If it drops to 0 HP, you can move the mark as a Bonus Action on a later turn.
spells.higher: Duration: up to 4 hours with a level 2 slot, 8 hours with level 3-4, 24 hours with level 5+.

spells.name: Ice Knife
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 Piercing damage. Hit or miss, the shard explodes: the target and each creature within 5 feet make a Dexterity save or take 2d6 Cold damage.
spells.higher: Cold damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Identify
spells.text: Learn a magic item's properties, how to use it, whether it needs Attunement and its charges, plus any spells affecting the item or creature you touch. Material: a pearl worth 100+ GP.

spells.name: Illusory Script
spells.text: Write on a surface so that only creatures you choose can read the message; others see unintelligible script or a false message you set. Truesight reveals it. Material: ink worth 10+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Inflict Wounds
spells.text: A creature you touch makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 Necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Insidious Rhythm
spells.text: A target makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on Intelligence checks and on Constitution saves to keep Concentration. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Jump
spells.text: Once per turn for the duration, the willing target can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.text: A creature's Speed increases by 10 feet.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.text: A willing creature not wearing armor has a base AC of 13 + its Dexterity modifier. Ends if it dons armor.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.text: Three darts each hit automatically for 1d4 + 1 Force damage, split among creatures you can see as you like.
spells.higher: One additional dart per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.text: Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target, and it can't be Charmed, Frightened or possessed by them. Material: a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Purify Food and Drink
spells.text: Remove poison and rot from nonmagical food and drink in a 5-foot-radius Sphere.

spells.name: Quick Clothier
spells.text: Restyle a set of nonmagical clothing no one is wearing: color, cut and decoration, up to a 15 GP value. It reverts when the spell ends.

spells.name: Ray of Sickness
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 2d8 Poison damage, and the target is Poisoned until the end of your next turn.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.text: A creature attacking the warded target or targeting it with a damaging spell must make a Wisdom save or choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. Ends if the warded creature attacks, casts a spell or deals damage.

spells.name: Searing Smite
spells.text: Cast right after hitting with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike: extra 1d6 Fire damage, and the target ignites, taking 1d6 Fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it succeeds on a Constitution save at the end of a turn.
spells.higher: Both damages increase by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Shield
spells.text: When you are hit by an attack or targeted by Magic Missile: +5 AC until the start of your next turn (including against the triggering attack), and no damage from Magic Missile.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.text: A creature gains +2 AC for the duration.

spells.name: Silent Image
spells.text: Create a visual illusion no larger than a 15-foot Cube that you can move with a Magic action. Physical interaction reveals it; a Study action allows an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your DC.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.text: Each creature you choose in a 5-foot-radius Sphere makes a Wisdom save or is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, then repeats the save; on a second failure it is Unconscious for the duration (ends if it takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it). Creatures that don't sleep or are immune to Exhaustion succeed automatically.

spells.name: Speak with Animals
spells.text: You can understand and talk with Beasts. Most can tell you about nearby places and creatures they have seen in the last day.

spells.name: Spellfire Flare
spells.text: Ranged spell attack that ignores Half and Three-Quarters Cover, dealing 2d10 Radiant damage on a hit.
spells.higher: One additional flare (separate attack) per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or falls Prone and is Incapacitated, unable to stand, laughing. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage (with Advantage if damaged).
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Tenser's Floating Disk
spells.text: A 3-foot-wide floating disk holds up to 500 pounds and follows you, staying within 20 feet. It ends if you move more than 100 feet away.

spells.name: Thunderous Smite
spells.text: Cast right after hitting with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike: extra 2d6 Thunder damage, and the target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet and knocked Prone.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.text: Each creature in a 15-foot Cube from you makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 Thunder damage and being pushed 10 feet on a failure, or half damage only on a success. Audible 300 feet away.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Unseen Servant
spells.text: An invisible, mindless force performs simple tasks on your command (Bonus Action): fetch, clean, mend, fold, serve. It has AC 10, 1 HP and Strength 2, and can't attack.
spells.higher: One additional servant per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Wardaway
spells.text: A target makes a Constitution save (Constructs and Undead succeed automatically). On a failure it takes 2d4 Force damage, its Speed is halved until the start of your next turn, and on its next turn it can take an action or a Bonus Action, not both. Half damage only on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 2d4 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Witch Bolt
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 2d12 Lightning damage. On each later turn you can use a Bonus Action to deal 1d12 Lightning damage to the target automatically, as long as it stays within range and has no Total Cover.
spells.higher: Initial damage increases by 1d12 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Wrathful Smite
spells.text: Cast right after hitting with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike: extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, and the target makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened for the duration, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.

spells.name: Aid
spells.text: Up to three creatures increase their Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points by 5 for the duration.
spells.higher: Increase by 5 more per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.text: Choose one form, and change it with a Magic action: Aquatic Adaptation (gills, Swim Speed equal to Speed), Change Appearance (look like another creature of your size and kind), or Natural Weapons (claws, fangs, horns or hooves: Unarmed Strikes deal 1d6 of the matching type and can use your spellcasting ability).

spells.name: Animal Messenger
spells.text: A Tiny Beast carries a message of up to 25 words to a place you describe, traveling about 25 miles per day (50 if it flies), and delivers it to the creature you describe.
spells.higher: Duration increases by 48 hours per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Arcane Lock
spells.text: A closed door, window, gate or container is magically locked. You and creatures you designate open it normally; Knock suppresses it for 10 minutes. Breaking or picking it has a DC 10 higher. Material: gold dust worth 25+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Arcane Vigor
spells.text: Expend one or two of your unspent Hit Point Dice, roll them and regain that total plus your spellcasting modifier in Hit Points.
spells.higher: You can expend one more Hit Die per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Augury
spells.text: Ask about a course of action you plan within the next 30 minutes and receive an omen: Weal, Woe, Weal and woe, or Indifference. Repeat castings before a Long Rest risk a random reading. Material: specially marked sticks or similar worth 25+ GP.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.text: A willing creature's AC can't be less than 17 for the duration.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Battle Familiar
spells.text: Summon a Celestial, Fey or Fiend familiar in Brute, Flyer or Stalker form that acts after you. Its Rend is a melee spell attack (5-foot reach) dealing 1d8 + 3 + the spell's level in Force damage, with attacks equal to half the spell level rounded down.
spells.higher: More damage, 5 more Hit Points and more Rend attacks per slot level above 2; the Brute's AC also rises.

spells.name: Beast Sense
spells.text: Touch a willing Beast and perceive through its senses until the spell ends, using its special senses. While you do, you benefit from them but are blind and deaf to your own surroundings.

spells.name: Blindness/Deafness
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save or is Blinded or Deafened (your choice). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Blur
spells.text: Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage. Creatures with Blindsight or Truesight aren't affected.

spells.name: Calm Emotions
spells.text: Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere makes a Charisma save (it can choose to fail). On a failure, either suppress effects making it Charmed or Frightened, or make it indifferent toward creatures it is hostile to (ends if it is attacked or harmed).

spells.name: Cloud of Daggers
spells.text: Spinning daggers fill a 5-foot Cube. A creature takes 4d4 Slashing damage when the Cube appears on it, when it enters, ends its turn there or the Cube moves into it (once per turn). As a Magic action you can move the Cube up to 30 feet.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 2d4 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Conjure Tools
spells.text: Create a set of Artisan's Tools of your choice that you are proficient with. They vanish when the spell ends or if they are more than 10 feet from you, but what you made with them remains.
spells.higher: With a level 3+ slot you craft nonmagical items as efficiently as two characters.

spells.name: Continual Flame
spells.text: A heatless flame as bright as a torch appears on an object. It can be covered but not smothered or quenched. Material: ruby dust worth 50+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Cordon of Arrows
spells.text: Plant four pieces of ammunition. When a creature other than those you designate first enters within 30 feet or ends its turn there, one piece flies at it: Dexterity save or 2d4 Piercing damage. The spell ends when no ammunition remains.
spells.higher: Two more pieces per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Crown of Madness
spells.text: A Humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed. At the start of its turns it must attack a creature you choose within its reach (or acts normally if none). You must use an action each turn to maintain control or the spell ends. It repeats the save at the end of its turns.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.text: Magical Darkness fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere at a point or on an object you hold. Darkvision can't see through it and nonmagical light can't illuminate it. Dispels light spells of level 2 or lower it overlaps.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.text: A willing creature gains Darkvision with a range of 150 feet.

spells.name: Death Armor
spells.text: The target has Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and once per turn a creature within 5 feet that hits it with a melee attack takes 2d4 Necrotic damage. Material: an onyx worth 50+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Deryan's Helpful Homunculi
spells.text: Intangible homunculus-like spirits help you craft: they count as proficient in Arcana and in the Artisan's Tools used, act as one assistant and halve the crafting time.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.text: Sense creatures with thoughts within 30 feet. As a Magic action you read a creature's surface thoughts, and can probe deeper: it makes a Wisdom save or you learn its reasoning, emotions and something on its mind.

spells.name: Disruptive Tune
spells.text: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere makes a Constitution save. On a failure it loses Concentration and has Disadvantage on Constitution saves to keep Concentration for the duration.

spells.name: Dragon's Breath
spells.text: A willing creature can take a Magic action to exhale a 15-foot Cone of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Poison (your choice when casting): Dexterity save, 3d6 damage, half on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Dueling Ground
spells.text: A 15-foot-radius Sphere holds a duel between two willing creatures. A duelist reduced to 0 HP (or hit by an instant-death effect) instead becomes Stable at 0 HP and is teleported out. Ends if another creature enters.
spells.higher: One additional willing creature per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Elminster's Elusion
spells.text: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects, and when a successful save would halve damage you take none instead.

spells.name: Enhance Ability
spells.text: Choose an ability: the target has Advantage on ability checks using it for the duration.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Enlarge/Reduce
spells.text: A creature or object grows or shrinks one size (an unwilling creature makes a Constitution save). Enlarged: Advantage on Strength checks and saves, weapons deal +1d4. Reduced: Disadvantage on those, weapons deal -1d4 (minimum 1).

spells.name: Enthrall
spells.text: Creatures of your choice that can hear you make a Wisdom save (Advantage if fighting you) or have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice anyone but you.

spells.name: Find Steed
spells.text: Summon an otherworldly steed (Celestial, Fey or Fiend) using the Otherworldly Steed stat block; it is Large, acts on your turn when you ride it and can't be controlled by others. It disappears at 0 HP or if you cast the spell again.
spells.higher: The steed's stats improve with higher slots (more HP and abilities such as flight at level 4+).

spells.name: Find Traps
spells.text: You sense any trap within range and line of sight and learn its general nature, but not its location.

spells.name: Flame Blade
spells.text: A fiery blade appears in your hand. As a Magic action you make a melee spell attack with it for 3d6 + your spellcasting modifier Fire damage. It sheds Bright Light in 10 feet.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Flaming Sphere
spells.text: A 5-foot sphere of fire appears. A creature ending its turn within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 Fire damage (half on success). As a Bonus Action you move it 30 feet; ramming a creature forces the save.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Gentle Repose
spells.text: A corpse doesn't decay and can't become Undead, and the days don't count toward time limits like Raise Dead's. Material: 2 copper pieces placed on the eyes.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.text: A 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line of wind. Each creature that starts its turn there makes a Strength save or is pushed 15 feet; moving against it costs double. Disperses gas and extinguishes unprotected flames. You can change its direction as a Bonus Action.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.text: A metal object glows red-hot. A creature touching it takes 2d8 Fire damage; if it holds or wears it, it makes a Constitution save or drops it, otherwise it has Disadvantage on attacks and checks until your next turn. Repeat the damage as a Bonus Action.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.text: A Humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.
spells.higher: One additional Humanoid per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Homunculus Servant
spells.text: Summon a loyal Tiny construct homunculus (AC 13, walk 20 ft, fly 30 ft) that acts after you, follows your orders and Dodges otherwise. Its Force Strike deals 1d6 + the spell's level in Force damage. Material: a gem worth 100+ GP.
spells.higher: Its Hit Points, Hit Dice, Force Strike damage and bonuses increase with the slot level.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.text: A creature has the Invisible condition. It ends early if the target makes an attack roll, deals damage or casts a spell.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Knock
spells.text: Unlock an object that is locked, stuck or barred, or suppress Arcane Lock for 10 minutes. It makes a loud knock audible 300 feet away.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.text: End one condition on a creature: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed or Poisoned.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.text: A creature or loose object up to 500 pounds rises up to 20 feet (an unwilling creature makes a Constitution save). You can move it up or down 20 feet each turn; a levitating creature can only move by pushing or pulling.

spells.name: Locate Animals or Plants
spells.text: Name a kind of Beast, Plant creature or nonmagical plant: you learn the direction and distance to the closest one within 5 miles.

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.text: Sense the direction of an object you describe within 1,000 feet. Blocked by lead.

spells.name: Magic Mouth
spells.text: Implant a message of up to 25 words on an object, spoken when a trigger you set occurs within 30 feet. Material: jade dust worth 10+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Magic Weapon
spells.text: A nonmagical weapon becomes a magic weapon with +1 to attack and damage rolls.
spells.higher: +2 with a level 3-5 slot, +3 with level 6+.

spells.name: Melf's Acid Arrow
spells.text: Ranged spell attack: 4d4 Acid damage on a hit and 2d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, half the initial damage only.
spells.higher: Both damages increase by 1d4 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Mind Spike
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d8 Psychic damage on a failure (half on success). On a failure you also know its location while on the same plane, and it can't hide from you or be Invisible to you.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.text: Three illusory duplicates appear. When an attack would hit you, roll a d6 for each remaining duplicate; on a 3+ one duplicate is hit and destroyed instead. Creatures with Blindsight or Truesight aren't fooled.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.text: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spells.name: Moonbeam
spells.text: A 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder of moonlight. A creature in it when it appears, entering it or ending its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 Radiant damage (half on success), once per turn; a shapeshifter that fails reverts. As a Magic action you can move it up to 60 feet.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Nystul's Magic Aura
spells.text: Change how a creature or object appears to divination: make an object read as magical or not (False Aura), or change a creature's apparent type or alignment (Mask).

spells.name: Pass without Trace
spells.text: You and allies in a 30-foot Emanation have +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.

spells.name: Phantasmal Force
spells.text: A creature makes an Intelligence save or perceives an illusion no larger than a 10-foot Cube that only it can see, and rationalizes it as real. If the illusion can harm, it deals 2d8 Psychic damage each turn the target is in it or within 5 feet. A Study action allows an Investigation check to see through it.

spells.name: Pinky Swear
spells.text: Make a promise of up to 25 words to the creature you touch. If you knowingly break it, it knows (within 1 mile) and you catch fire, taking 1 Fire damage at the start of each of your turns.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.text: Up to five creatures gain the benefits of a Short Rest and regain 2d8 Hit Points. A creature can't benefit again until it finishes a Long Rest.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Protection from Poison
spells.text: End the Poisoned condition on a creature. For the duration it has Advantage on saves against Poisoned and Resistance to Poison damage.

spells.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save. On a failure it has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 1d8 from all its damage rolls; it repeats the save at the end of each turn. On a success it has Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

spells.name: Rope Trick
spells.text: A rope leads to an invisible extradimensional space that holds up to eight Medium creatures. Attacks and spells can't cross into or out of it.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.text: Hurl three rays, each a ranged spell attack for 2d6 Fire damage, at one or more targets.
spells.higher: One additional ray per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Searing Orb
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 3d4 Radiant damage. Hit or miss, the orb bursts: the target and each creature within 10 feet of it make a Constitution save or are Blinded until the end of their next turn.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d4 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: See Invisibility
spells.text: You see Invisible creatures and objects, and into the Ethereal Plane, as translucent shapes.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.text: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere makes a Constitution save, taking 3d8 Thunder damage on a failure or half on a success; Constructs have Disadvantage. Unattended nonmagical objects also take the damage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Shining Smite
spells.text: Cast right after hitting with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike: extra 2d6 Radiant damage, and the target sheds Bright Light in 5 feet, attacks against it have Advantage and it can't be Invisible.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Silence
spells.text: No sound can be created in or pass through a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Creatures inside are Deafened and immune to Thunder damage, and can't cast spells with a Verbal component.

spells.name: Spider Climb
spells.text: A willing creature can climb surfaces and ceilings with its hands free, and gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Spike Growth
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of ground becomes Difficult Terrain with hidden thorns. A creature takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 5 feet it moves in the area. It's camouflaged: a Search action with Perception or Survival against your DC reveals it.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.text: A floating spectral weapon appears. When you cast it, and as a Bonus Action on later turns, move it up to 20 feet and make a melee spell attack with it for 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier Force damage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.text: Suggest a reasonable course of activity (up to 25 words) to a creature that can hear and understand you. On a failed Wisdom save it pursues it. Ends if you or allies damage it.

spells.name: Summon Beast
spells.text: Summon a Bestial Spirit (Air, Land or Water) that obeys you and acts right after you. It attacks with Rend and uses the spell's level for its AC, Hit Points and damage. Material: a feather, fur or fish tail in a gilded acorn worth 200+ GP.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Tortoise Shell
spells.text: A willing creature gains +3 AC while it stays still. If it moves or uses its action, Bonus Action or Reaction to move, the bonus drops to +1 until the start of its next turn.

spells.name: Uncertain Footing
spells.text: Up to three creatures make an Intelligence save. On a failure a target's Speed is halved and it can't Dash; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Warding Bond
spells.text: A willing creature within 60 feet of you gets +1 AC and saves and Resistance to all damage; whenever it takes damage, you take the same amount. Material: two platinum rings worth 50+ GP each, worn by both.

spells.name: Web
spells.text: Sticky webs fill a 20-foot Cube, making it Difficult Terrain and Lightly Obscured. A creature entering or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity save or is Restrained; it can take an action for a Strength (Athletics) check against your DC to break free. The webs are flammable.

spells.name: Wither and Bloom
spells.text: Creatures you choose in a 10-foot-radius Sphere make a Constitution save, taking 3d6 Necrotic damage (half on success). One creature you choose in the area can spend a Hit Point Die to heal its roll + your spellcasting modifier.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 and one more Hit Point Die can be spent per slot level above 2.

spells.name: Zone of Truth
spells.text: Creatures in a 15-foot-radius Sphere make a Charisma save; those that fail can't speak a deliberate lie while in it. You know who succeeded or failed.

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.text: Raise a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid as a Skeleton or Zombie under your control for 24 hours. A Bonus Action commands any of them within 60 feet. Recast before 24 hours pass to keep control of up to four.
spells.higher: Two more undead per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Astral Flood
spells.text: Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 4d10 Cold or Radiant damage (your choice) on a failure, or half with no rider on a success. Cold: Disadvantage on its next D20 Test before the end of your next turn. Radiant: Blinded until then.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Aura of Vitality
spells.text: A 30-foot Emanation of healing energy. When you cast it and as a Bonus Action on later turns, one creature in it (including you) regains 2d6 Hit Points.

spells.name: Beacon of Hope
spells.text: Any number of creatures have Advantage on Wisdom saves and Death Saving Throws, and regain the maximum possible Hit Points from any healing.

spells.name: Bestow Curse
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or is cursed: Disadvantage on checks and saves with one ability, Disadvantage on attacks against you, a Wisdom save each turn or it wastes its action, or your attacks and spells deal it an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage.
spells.higher: Level 4: up to 10 minutes. Level 5-6: 8 hours. Level 7-8: 24 hours. Level 9: until dispelled, and no Concentration from level 5.

spells.name: Blinding Smite
spells.text: Cast right after hitting with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike: extra 3d8 Radiant damage, and the target is Blinded. It makes a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Blink
spells.text: At the end of each of your turns, roll a d20: on 11+ you vanish to the Ethereal Plane until the start of your next turn, then return to a space you choose within 10 feet of where you left.

spells.name: Cacophonic Shield
spells.text: A 10-foot Emanation of noise. Creatures you don't exempt that enter it or start or end their turn there make a Constitution save (once per turn): 3d6 Thunder damage and Deafened until the start of your next turn, or half damage on a success. You have Resistance to Thunder and ranged attacks against you have Disadvantage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Call Lightning
spells.text: A storm cloud appears 100 feet up. When you cast it and as a Magic action on later turns, call a bolt to a point under it: each creature within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d10 Lightning damage (half on success). If it's already stormy, the damage increases by 1d10.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Catnap
spells.text: Up to three willing creatures fall Unconscious for the duration (ends if damaged or woken with an action). A target that sleeps the full time gains the benefits of a Short Rest and can't be affected again until a Long Rest.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.text: Create an invisible sensor at a familiar or obvious location within 1 mile, and see or hear through it (switch as a Bonus Action). Material: a focus worth 100+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Conjure Animals
spells.text: A Large, intangible pack of spectral beasts appears. You have Advantage on Strength saves within 5 feet of it, and can move it 30 feet on your turn. When it moves within 10 feet of a creature, or a creature enters or ends its turn within 10 feet of it, the creature makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d10 Slashing damage (once per turn).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Conjure Barrage
spells.text: Spectral copies of your weapon or ammunition fill a 60-foot Cone. Each creature you choose there makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d8 Force damage on a failure or half on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Conjure Constructs
spells.text: Intangible orderly spirits fill a Medium space. You can move them 30 feet on your turn, and as a Magic action command them to deal 3d6 Force damage (Dexterity save for half) or grant 1d6 + your spellcasting modifier Temporary Hit Points to a creature or object within 5 feet.
spells.higher: Damage and Temporary Hit Points increase by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.text: When a creature you can see casts a spell, it makes a Constitution save. On a failure the spell dissipates with no effect and the action, Bonus Action or Reaction is wasted, but the slot isn't expended.

spells.name: Create Food and Water
spells.text: Create 45 pounds of bland food and 30 gallons of fresh water, enough for fifteen Humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours. The food spoils after 24 hours.

spells.name: Crusader's Mantle
spells.text: Allies in a 30-foot Emanation (and you) deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage when they hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike.

spells.name: Daylight
spells.text: A 60-foot-radius Sphere of Bright Light (plus 60 feet of Dim Light) at a point or on an object. It dispels magical Darkness of level 3 or lower it overlaps.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.text: End spells of level 3 or lower on a creature, object or magical effect. For each higher-level spell, make an ability check with your spellcasting ability (DC 10 + its level) to end it.
spells.higher: Automatically ends spells of a level equal to or lower than the slot used.

spells.name: Elemental Weapon
spells.text: A nonmagical weapon becomes magic: +1 to attack rolls and an extra 1d4 damage of a type you choose (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder).
spells.higher: Level 5-6: +2 and 2d4. Level 7+: +3 and 3d4.

spells.name: Fear
spells.text: Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Wisdom save or drops what it holds and is Frightened, Dashing away from you on its turns. It repeats the save at the end of turns when it can't see you.

spells.name: Feign Death
spells.text: A willing creature appears dead: it is Blinded and Incapacitated, its Speed is 0, it has Resistance to all damage except Psychic, and diseases and poisons are suspended.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius Sphere explodes. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Flammable unattended objects ignite.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Fly
spells.text: A willing creature gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover. It falls if the spell ends while aloft (unless it can stop the fall).
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Gaseous Form
spells.text: A willing creature becomes a misty cloud: Fly Speed 10 feet (hover), Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing, Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves, can pass through small gaps. It can't attack or cast spells.

spells.name: Glyph of Warding
spells.text: Inscribe a nearly invisible glyph that triggers on conditions you set. Explosive Rune: 20-foot-radius Sphere, Dexterity save, 5d8 damage of a chosen type (half on success). Spell Glyph: store a spell of level 3 or lower that triggers. Material: diamond dust worth 200+ GP, consumed.
spells.higher: Explosive Rune damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3, and a Spell Glyph can hold a spell up to the slot's level.

spells.name: Haste
spells.text: A willing creature's Speed doubles, it gains +2 AC, Advantage on Dexterity saves, and an extra action each turn (Attack with one weapon attack only, Dash, Disengage, Hide or Utilize). When the spell ends, it can't move or act until after its next turn.

spells.name: Hunger of Hadar
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of darkness and cold that is Difficult Terrain. A creature starting its turn there takes 2d6 Cold damage; one ending its turn there makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 Acid damage.
spells.higher: Cold or Acid damage (your choice) increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.text: Each creature in a 30-foot Cube that sees the pattern makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed: Incapacitated with Speed 0. It ends for a creature that takes damage or is shaken awake with an action.

spells.name: Inflict Doubt
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Laeral's Silver Lance
spells.text: A 120-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line of silver force. Creatures you choose in it make a Strength save, taking 3d10 Force damage and falling Prone on a failure, or half damage on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
spells.text: A 10-foot Emanation dome holds up to nine Medium creatures. Spells and magical effects can't extend through it, and creatures and objects can't pass in except those inside at casting. The interior is comfortable and dry. It ends if you leave it.

spells.name: Lightning Arrow
spells.text: Cast after a ranged weapon attack, hit or miss: the target takes 4d8 Lightning damage on a hit (half on a miss) instead of the weapon's damage, and each creature within 10 feet makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d8 Lightning damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Both damages increase by 1d8 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.text: A 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Magic Circle
spells.text: A 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall Cylinder against Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends or Undead (choose): they can't willingly enter it, have Disadvantage on attacks against those inside, and can't charm, frighten or possess them. You can reverse it to trap one inside. Material: salt and silver powder worth 100+ GP, consumed.
spells.higher: Duration increases by 1 hour per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Major Image
