spells.text: Create an illusion of an object, creature or phenomenon up to a 20-foot Cube, with sound, smell and temperature. Move it with a Magic action. A Study action allows an Investigation check to see through it.
spells.higher: With a level 4+ slot it lasts until dispelled without Concentration.

spells.name: Mass Healing Word
spells.text: Up to six creatures you can see regain 2d4 + your spellcasting modifier Hit Points.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 1d4 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Meld into Stone
spells.text: Step into a stone object or surface large enough to hold you. You can hear outside and cast spells on yourself. Damaging the stone may expel you (6d6 Force if destroyed).

spells.name: Nondetection
spells.text: A creature, place or object can't be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through magical scrying sensors. Material: diamond dust worth 25+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Phantom Steed
spells.text: A Large quasi-real horse with Speed 100 feet appears for a rider you designate. It disappears if it takes damage.

spells.name: Plant Growth
spells.text: Overgrowth: plants in a 100-foot radius become thick, and each 5 feet of movement costs 20 feet (you can exclude areas). Enrichment: plants in a half-mile radius become enriched and yield twice the food for a year.

spells.name: Protection from Energy
spells.text: A willing creature has Resistance to one damage type: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.text: All curses on a creature or object end. A cursed magic item stays cursed, but its curse is broken on the owner so they can remove it.

spells.name: Revivify
spells.text: A creature that died within the last minute returns to life with 1 Hit Point (not from old age, and with its body intact). Material: a diamond worth 300+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Sending
spells.text: Send a message of up to 25 words to a familiar creature anywhere; it can reply the same way. Crossing planes has a 5% chance to fail.

spells.name: Sleet Storm
spells.text: A 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall Cylinder of sleet is Heavily Obscured and Difficult Terrain and douses flames. A creature entering or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity save or falls Prone and loses Concentration.

spells.name: Slow
spells.text: Up to six creatures in a 40-foot Cube make a Wisdom save. On a failure: Speed halved, -2 AC and Dexterity saves, no Reactions, only an action or a Bonus Action per turn, and one attack only. They repeat the save at the end of each turn.

spells.name: Speak with Dead
spells.text: A corpse with a mouth answers up to five questions with what it knew in life. It can't be one targeted by this spell in the last 10 days, and it isn't compelled to be truthful.

spells.name: Speak with Plants
spells.text: Plants within 30 feet become sentient enough to communicate and can tell you about the area in the last day. You can turn Difficult Terrain from plants normal, or vice versa.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.text: Spirits fill a 15-foot Emanation; creatures you exempt are unaffected. Others there have their Speed halved, and a creature entering it, that it moves into, or ending its turn there makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d8 Radiant (or Necrotic) damage, half on success, once per turn.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Stinking Cloud
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of nauseating gas is Heavily Obscured. A creature starting its turn there makes a Constitution save or is Poisoned until the end of the turn, spending its action retching.

spells.name: Summon Fey
spells.text: Summon a Fey Spirit (Fuming, Mirthful or Tricksy) that obeys you, acts after you and can teleport with Fey Step. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: a gilded flower worth 300+ GP.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Summon Undead
spells.text: Summon an Undead Spirit (Ghostly, Putrid or Skeletal) that obeys you and acts after you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: a gilded skull worth 300+ GP.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Sylune's Viper
spells.text: You gain 15 Temporary Hit Points and a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. As a Magic action, a spectral viper bites a creature within 50 feet (ranged spell attack): 1d6 Force damage and Poisoned (and Incapacitated) until the start of your next turn.
spells.higher: 5 more Temporary Hit Points and 1d6 more damage per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Tongues
spells.text: The creature understands any spoken or signed language it hears, and its speech is understood by any creature that knows a language.

spells.name: Vampiric Touch
spells.text: Make a melee spell attack: 3d6 Necrotic damage and you regain half the damage dealt. You can repeat the attack as a Magic action on later turns.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.text: Up to ten willing creatures can breathe underwater for the duration.

spells.name: Water Walk
spells.text: Up to ten willing creatures can move across liquids (water, acid, mud, snow, lava without harm from heat) as if solid ground.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.text: A wall of wind up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high and 1 foot thick. When it appears, creatures in it make a Strength save, taking 4d8 Bludgeoning damage (half on success). It blocks gas, fog, small flying creatures and ranged weapon ammunition.

spells.name: Arcane Eye
spells.text: An Invisible floating eye with Darkvision 30 feet that you see through. As a Bonus Action you move it up to 30 feet in any direction; it can pass through 1-inch openings but not solid barriers.

spells.name: Aura of Life
spells.text: You and allies in a 30-foot Emanation have Resistance to Necrotic damage and your Hit Point maximum can't be reduced. An ally with 0 HP that starts its turn there regains 1 Hit Point.

spells.name: Aura of Purity
spells.text: You and allies in a 30-foot Emanation have Resistance to Poison damage, can't be Poisoned, and have Advantage on saves against Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned and Stunned.

spells.name: Backlash
spells.text: When you take damage, reduce it by 4d6 + your spellcasting modifier. If the source is a creature within 60 feet, it makes a Constitution save, taking 4d6 Force damage (half on success).
spells.higher: Reduction and damage increase by 1d6 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.text: A creature makes a Charisma save or is sent to a harmless demiplane, Incapacitated. If it is from another plane and the spell lasts the full minute, it returns to its home plane instead of coming back.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Blight
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Plant creatures have Disadvantage and take maximum damage; a nonmagical plant simply withers.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Charm Monster
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save (Advantage if you or allies are fighting it) or is Charmed by you. It ends if you or allies damage it.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Compulsion
spells.text: Creatures you choose make a Wisdom save. Those that fail are Charmed, and as a Bonus Action you can choose a direction: each must use as much movement as possible toward it on its next turn (it can act first).

spells.name: Confusion
spells.text: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere makes a Wisdom save or can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions and rolls 1d10 each turn: move randomly, do nothing, attack a random adjacent creature, or act normally. It repeats the save at the end of its turns.
spells.higher: Sphere radius increases by 5 feet per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Conjure Minor Elementals
spells.text: Elemental spirits swirl in a 15-foot Emanation. Your attacks that hit a creature in it deal an extra 2d8 damage of a type you choose (Acid, Cold, Fire or Lightning), and the area is Difficult Terrain for your enemies.
spells.higher: Extra damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
spells.text: Fey spirits fill a 10-foot Emanation. When it reaches a creature, or a creature enters it or starts its turn there, you can force a Wisdom save: 5d8 Force damage, half on success (once per turn). You can also Disengage as a Bonus Action.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Control Water
spells.text: Control water in a 100-foot Cube: Flood (raise level 20 feet or make a wave), Part Water, Redirect Flow, or a Whirlpool that pulls creatures in (Strength save or 2d8 Bludgeoning and Restrained).

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.text: The first time the target would drop to 0 Hit Points, it drops to 1 instead and the spell ends. It also negates one instant-death effect.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.text: Teleport to a spot within range you can see or describe, optionally bringing one willing creature within 5 feet. If the destination is occupied, you each take 4d6 Force damage and fail to teleport.

spells.name: Distorted Distance
spells.text: A 60-foot-radius Sphere warps space. Each creature you can see in it either makes an Intelligence save against 2d10 Psychic damage or gains +20 feet of Speed (your choice). You can apply one of the effects again when a creature enters or ends its turn there (once per turn).

spells.name: Divination
spells.text: Ask one question about a goal, event or activity within the next 7 days and get a truthful (possibly cryptic) answer. Repeat castings before a Long Rest risk a random answer. Material: incense worth 25+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Dominate Beast
spells.text: A Beast makes a Wisdom save (Advantage if fighting you) or is Charmed and follows your telepathic commands. Each time it takes damage it repeats the save.
spells.higher: Level 5: up to 10 minutes. Level 6: 1 hour. Level 7+: 8 hours.

spells.name: Doomtide
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of magical Darkness. Creatures in it make a Wisdom save, taking 5d6 Psychic damage and subtracting 1d6 from saving throws until the end of their next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.

spells.name: Evard's Black Tentacles
spells.text: A 20-foot square fills with tentacles and is Difficult Terrain. A creature in it when it appears, entering it or ending its turn there makes a Strength save or takes 3d6 Bludgeoning damage and is Restrained. It can use an action for an Athletics or Acrobatics check to escape.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Fabricate
spells.text: Turn raw materials into products: up to a Large object (or a 10-foot Cube) of wood, cloth, rope and similar, or a Medium object (or a 5-foot Cube) of minerals. Fine work needs proficiency with the right Artisan's Tools.

spells.name: Festering Blast
spells.text: A 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line of miasma. Each creature in it makes a Constitution save or takes 4d10 Necrotic damage and is Poisoned, taking 2d10 Poison damage at the start of each of its turns and repeating the save at the end of them.
spells.higher: Initial damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.text: Wispy flames give you Resistance to Cold (warm shield) or Fire (chill shield). A creature within 5 feet that hits you with a melee attack takes 2d8 Fire or Cold damage.

spells.name: Fount of Moonlight
spells.text: You glow with moonlight (Bright Light 20 feet), have Resistance to Radiant damage, and your melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 Radiant damage. When a creature within 60 feet damages you, you can use your Reaction to force a Constitution save or Blind it until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
spells.text: Difficult Terrain doesn't slow the target, magic can't reduce its Speed or make it Paralyzed or Restrained, it can spend 5 feet of movement to escape nonmagical restraints or grapples, and moving underwater has no penalty.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Giant Insect
spells.text: Summon a Giant Insect spirit (centipede, spider or wasp) that obeys you and acts after you, using its stat block with the spell's level (AC 11 + level, 30 HP plus 10 per level above 4, poison jab and web bolt).
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Grasping Vine
spells.text: A vine sprouts from the ground. When you cast it and as a Bonus Action on later turns, it makes a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet: 4d8 Bludgeoning damage and the target is pulled up to 30 feet toward the vine and possibly Grappled.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.text: A creature has the Invisible condition for the duration, even while attacking or casting spells.

spells.name: Guardian of Faith
spells.text: A Large spectral guardian occupies a space. An enemy that moves within 10 feet of it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity save, taking 20 Radiant damage (half on success). The guardian vanishes after dealing 60 damage total.

spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
spells.text: Make natural terrain in a 150-foot Cube look, sound and smell like another kind of terrain. A Study action allows an Investigation check to see through it.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.text: Hail pounds a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 Bludgeoning and 4d6 Cold damage (half on success). The area is Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn.
spells.higher: Bludgeoning damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Leomund's Secret Chest
spells.text: Hide a chest and its contents on the Ethereal Plane; you can recall it with an action using its miniature replica. After 60 days there's a growing chance the spell ends. Material: a chest worth 5,000+ GP and a replica worth 50+ GP.

spells.name: Locate Creature
spells.text: Sense the direction of a creature you describe or know within 1,000 feet. Running water 10 feet wide blocks it.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
spells.text: An invisible watchdog barks when an unauthorized creature comes within 30 feet. At the start of your turn it can bite a hostile creature within 5 feet: melee spell attack for 4d8 Force damage.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
spells.text: Secure an area up to a 100-foot Cube: choose to block sound, sight, divination sensors, teleportation or planar travel into or out of it.
spells.higher: The area can be up to 100 feet larger per slot level above 4, and casting it daily for a year makes it permanent.

spells.name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
spells.text: A creature or object of Large size or smaller is enclosed in a sphere of force (Dexterity save to avoid). Nothing passes through it; the creature inside can roll it at half Speed.

spells.name: Phantasmal Killer
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 4d10 Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls, repeating the save at the end of each turn (taking the damage again on a failure). Half damage only on a success.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or turns into a Beast of CR up to its level (or CR). It gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Beast's HP and keeps its personality. The spell ends when those Temporary Hit Points are gone or it dies.

spells.name: Spellfire Storm
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder of Bright Light. Creatures in it make a Constitution save, taking 4d10 Radiant damage (half on success), and again when they enter or end a turn there (once per turn). Casting a spell inside needs a Constitution save or the spell fails (the slot isn't spent).
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Staggering Smite
spells.text: Cast right after hitting with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike: extra 4d6 Psychic damage, and the target makes a Wisdom save or is Stunned until the end of your next turn.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Sticks to Snakes
spells.text: Turn up to four nonmagical sticks (torches, spears, staffs) into Venomous Snakes friendly to you; a creature holding one can resist with a Charisma save. They act after you and obey Bonus Action commands within 500 feet, Dodging otherwise. A snake reduced to 0 HP reverts, with excess damage going to the object.
spells.higher: Two more objects per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Stone Shape
spells.text: Reshape a stone object of Medium size or smaller (or a 5-foot section) into any form: a weapon, a coffer, a passage, a sealed door. Fine details and mechanical parts are crude.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.text: A willing creature has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage. Material: diamond dust worth 100+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Summon Aberration
spells.text: Summon an Aberrant Spirit (Beholderkin, Mind Flayer or Slaad) that obeys you and acts after you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: a pickled tentacle and eyeball in a vial worth 400+ GP.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Summon Construct
spells.text: Summon a Construct Spirit (Clay, Metal or Stone) that obeys you and acts after you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: a lockbox worth 400+ GP.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Summon Elemental
spells.text: Summon an Elemental Spirit (Air, Earth, Fire or Water) that obeys you and acts after you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: air, a pebble, ash and water in a gold-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Vitriolic Sphere
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of acid. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save: on a failure 10d4 Acid damage plus 5d4 more at the end of its next turn; half the initial damage only on a success.
spells.higher: Initial damage increases by 2d4 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.text: A wall of fire up to 60 feet long, 20 high and 1 thick (or a ring 20 feet across). Creatures in it when it appears make a Dexterity save for 5d8 Fire damage (half on success). One side you choose deals 5d8 Fire damage to a creature ending its turn within 10 feet or inside.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

spells.name: Zone of Amicability
spells.text: A 60-foot Emanation of goodwill. When you make an ability check to influence a creature in it, any d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as a 10.

spells.name: Alustriel's Mooncloak
spells.text: A 20-foot Emanation of Dim Light. You and allies in it have Half Cover and Resistance to Cold, Lightning and Radiant damage. You can end the spell early to succeed on a failed save against Frightened, Grappled or Restrained (Reaction), or to heal yourself or an ally in it 4d10 + your spellcasting modifier (Magic action).

spells.name: Animate Objects
spells.text: Animate nonmagical unattended objects up to your spellcasting modifier (Large counts as two, Huge as three). They use the Animated Object stat block, act after you and obey Bonus Action commands within 500 feet. At 0 HP an object reverts, carrying over excess damage.
spells.higher: Slam damage increases by 1d4 (Medium or smaller), 1d6 (Large) or 1d12 (Huge) per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Antilife Shell
spells.text: A 10-foot Emanation keeps creatures other than Constructs and Undead from passing or reaching through it. Spells and ranged attacks can still cross it. If you move so that an affected creature would be forced through the barrier, the spell ends.

spells.name: Awaken
spells.text: A Huge or smaller Beast or Plant with Intelligence 3 or less gains Intelligence 10 and the ability to speak one language you know. It is Charmed by you for 30 days. Material: an agate worth 1,000+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Banishing Smite
spells.text: Cast right after hitting with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike: extra 5d10 Force damage. If the target has 50 Hit Points or fewer, it makes a Charisma save or is banished to a harmless demiplane, Incapacitated, until the spell ends.

spells.name: Bigby's Hand
spells.text: A Large force hand appears. As a Bonus Action you move it 60 feet and use it: Clenched Fist (melee spell attack, 5d8 Force), Forceful Hand (push), Grasping Hand (grapple, crush 4d6 + modifier) or Interposing Hand (Half Cover and blocks movement).
spells.higher: Clenched Fist damage increases by 2d8 and Grasping Hand by 2d6 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Circle of Power
spells.text: You and allies in a 30-foot Emanation have Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects. When a successful save would halve damage, they take none instead.

spells.name: Cloudkill
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of poisonous fog, Heavily Obscured. A creature in it makes a Constitution save when it appears, enters or ends its turn there: 5d8 Poison damage, half on success. The fog moves 10 feet away from you each turn.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Commune
spells.text: Contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three yes-or-no questions before the spell ends. Repeat castings before a Long Rest risk no answer.

spells.name: Commune with Nature
spells.text: Learn up to three facts about the area within 3 miles (1,000 feet underground): terrain, water, plants, minerals, creatures, influence from other planes, buildings.

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.text: Each creature in a 60-foot Cone makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature killed becomes a frozen statue.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Conjure Elemental
spells.text: A Large intangible elemental spirit of Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder appears. While it holds no one, a creature that enters its space or starts its turn within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 8d8 damage and is Restrained, taking 4d8 at the start of each of its turns and repeating the save to escape.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Conjure Volley
spells.text: Spectral weapons rain on a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder. Each creature you choose there makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d8 Force damage on a failure or half on a success.

spells.name: Contact Other Plane
spells.text: Ask an otherworldly entity up to five questions. First make a DC 15 Intelligence save: on a failure you take 6d6 Psychic damage and are Incapacitated until a Long Rest, getting no answers.

spells.name: Contagion
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save or takes 11d8 Necrotic damage and is Poisoned, with Disadvantage on saves of an ability you chose. It repeats the save each turn: three successes end it, three failures make it last 7 days.

spells.name: Creation
spells.text: Create a nonliving object of vegetable matter or mineral up to a 5-foot Cube. Duration depends on the material: from 1 day (vegetable) down to 1 minute (precious metals or gems). It can't serve as a spell's material component.
spells.higher: The Cube grows by 5 feet per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Destructive Wave
spells.text: Creatures you choose in a 30-foot Emanation make a Constitution save, taking 5d6 Thunder plus 5d6 Radiant or Necrotic damage and falling Prone on a failure, or half damage on a success.

spells.name: Dispel Evil and Good
spells.text: Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead have Disadvantage on attacks against you. You can end the spell to break their charm, fright or possession on a creature, or make a melee spell attack to send one home (Charisma save).

spells.name: Dominate Person
spells.text: A Humanoid makes a Wisdom save (Advantage if fighting you) or is Charmed and follows your telepathic commands. Each time it takes damage it repeats the save.
spells.higher: Level 6: up to 10 minutes. Level 7: 1 hour. Level 8+: 8 hours.

spells.name: Dream
spells.text: Shape the dreams of a creature you know on the same plane: talk with it, or send a nightmare (Wisdom save or no rest benefits and 3d6 Psychic damage on waking).

spells.name: Enervation
spells.text: A tendril of dark energy lashes a creature: Dexterity save or it takes Necrotic damage and you can drain it again as a Bonus Action on later turns, regaining half the damage each time. On a success it takes half and the spell ends.
spells.higher: Initial damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Flame Strike
spells.text: A 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder of divine fire. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d6 Fire and 5d6 Radiant damage on a failure or half on a success.
spells.higher: Fire and Radiant damage each increase by 1d6 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Geas
spells.text: A creature that understands you makes a Wisdom save or must follow a command; each day it acts against it, it takes 5d10 Psychic damage (once per day). Charmed by you for the duration.
spells.higher: Level 7-8: 365 days. Level 9: until ended by Remove Curse, Greater Restoration or Wish.

spells.name: Grave Ground
spells.text: Up to four connected 10-foot squares become Difficult Terrain of grasping dead. Enemies in them, entering or ending a turn there make a Strength save: 6d6 Necrotic damage and -1d6 to their damage rolls until the end of their next turn (half damage on success), once per turn.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.text: Remove one: an Exhaustion level, Charmed or Petrified, a curse (including Attunement to a cursed item), any reduction to an ability score, or any reduction to the Hit Point maximum. Material: diamond dust worth 100+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Hallow
spells.text: Bless an area up to 60 feet in radius: Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead can't enter it or charm, frighten or possess creatures in it. Add one extra effect such as Courage, Darkness, Daylight, Energy Protection, Silence or Tongues. Material: incense worth 1,000+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Hold Monster
spells.text: A creature (not Undead) makes a Wisdom save or is Paralyzed, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
spells.higher: One additional creature per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Insect Plague
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of locusts is Lightly Obscured and Difficult Terrain. A creature in it when it appears, entering or ending its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 4d10 Piercing damage (half on success), once per turn.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance
spells.text: A 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder of light and thunder. Creatures inside are Blinded and Deafened and can't cast Verbal spells. A creature makes a Constitution save when it appears, enters or ends its turn there (once per turn): 2d10 Radiant and 2d10 Thunder damage, half on success.
spells.higher: Each damage type increases by 1d10 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Legend Lore
spells.text: Name a famous person, place or object and learn significant lore about it, more if you already know details. Material: incense worth 250+ GP (consumed) and four ivory strips worth 50+ GP each.

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spells.text: Up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere regain 5d8 + your spellcasting modifier Hit Points.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Mislead
spells.text: You become Invisible and an illusory double appears. As a Bonus Action you move the double up to 60 feet and can see and hear through it. Invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.

spells.name: Modify Memory
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save (Advantage if fighting you) or is Charmed and Incapacitated while you alter its memory of an event within the last 24 hours lasting up to 10 minutes.
spells.higher: Level 6: past 7 days. Level 7: past 30 days. Level 8: past year. Level 9: any time.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Lucubration
spells.text: Regain up to two expended spell slots of level 2 or lower.
spells.higher: With a level 6-7 slot you can regain slots up to level 3; with level 8+, up to level 4.

spells.name: Negative Energy Flood
spells.text: A non-Undead target makes a Constitution save, taking 3d10 + 25 Necrotic damage (half on success); a Humanoid killed rises as a Zombie under your command for 24 hours. An Undead target gains 3d10 Temporary Hit Points instead.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 5.

spells.name: Passwall
spells.text: A passage up to 5 feet wide, 8 high and 20 deep opens in wood, plaster or stone. When it ends, creatures inside are shunted out safely.

spells.name: Planar Binding
spells.text: A Celestial, Elemental, Fey or Fiend makes a Charisma save or must serve you for the duration. Material: a jewel worth 1,000+ GP, consumed.
spells.higher: Level 6: 10 days. Level 7: 30 days. Level 8: 180 days. Level 9: a year and a day.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.text: A creature dead up to 10 days returns to life with 1 Hit Point. It has a -4 penalty to D20 Tests that drops by 1 each Long Rest. Material: a diamond worth 500+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
spells.text: Up to eight willing creatures share a telepathic link and can communicate at any distance on the same plane.

spells.name: Reincarnate
spells.text: A creature dead up to 10 days returns in a new adult body of a random or chosen species. Material: rare oils worth 1,000+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.text: See and hear a creature on the same plane, which makes a Wisdom save modified by how well you know it and whether you have something of it. On a success you can't target it again for 24 hours. Material: a focus worth 1,000+ GP.

spells.name: Seeming
spells.text: Change the appearance of any number of creatures you can see (unwilling ones make a Charisma save). A Study action allows an Investigation check to see through it.

spells.name: Songal's Elemental Suffusion
spells.text: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder: you gain Resistance to it and a Fly Speed of 30 feet (hover). When you cast it and at the start of each of your turns, creatures in a 15-foot Emanation make a Dexterity save or take 2d6 damage of that type and fall Prone (half damage on success).

spells.name: Spirit Lantern
spells.text: A lantern sheds Dim Light in 60 feet and gathers a soul fragment when an enemy dies in it (up to your spellcasting modifier). As a Bonus Action spend one: Drain Life (4d8 + modifier Necrotic, Constitution save for half), heal an Undead 4d8 + modifier, or give attacks against an ally Disadvantage until your next turn.

spells.name: Steel Wind Strike
spells.text: Make a melee spell attack against up to five creatures, each taking 6d10 Force damage on a hit. Then teleport to a space within 5 feet of one of them.

spells.name: Summon Celestial
spells.text: Summon a Celestial Spirit (Avenger or Defender) that obeys you and acts after you; it can also heal. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: a reliquary worth 500+ GP.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Summon Dragon
spells.text: Summon a Large Draconic Spirit (AC 14 + level, 50 HP plus 10 per level above 5) that obeys you and acts after you, with Rend attacks (1d6 + 4 + level Piercing) and a breath weapon. Material: an object with a dragon's image worth 500+ GP.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Summon Plant
spells.text: Summon a plant spirit (Fungus, Tree or Vine) that acts after you and obeys your spoken commands. Its stats scale with the spell's level.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level: 10 more HP per level, more attacks and damage.

spells.name: Swift Quiver
spells.text: As a Bonus Action on each turn you can make two attacks with a ranged weapon; the spell conjures the ammunition, which vanishes after it hits or misses.

spells.name: Synaptic Static
spells.text: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere makes an Intelligence save, taking 8d6 Psychic damage on a failure (half on success). On a failure it also subtracts 1d6 from attack rolls, ability checks and Concentration saves for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn.

spells.name: Telekinesis
spells.text: As a Magic action each turn, move a Huge or smaller creature (contested by its Strength save) or an object up to 1,000 pounds up to 30 feet, and hold it Restrained. You can manipulate objects finely.

spells.name: Teleportation Circle
spells.text: Draw a circle linked to a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know; creatures entering it appear at the destination. Material: rare inks worth 50+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Tree Stride
spells.text: Once per turn, step into a living tree and out of another of the same kind within 500 feet, using 5 feet of movement.

spells.name: Wall of Force
spells.text: An invisible wall of force (ten 10-foot panels, or a hemisphere or sphere up to 10 feet radius). Nothing physical passes through it; it is immune to damage and extends into the Ethereal Plane. Disintegrate destroys it.

spells.name: Wall of Stone
spells.text: A stone wall of ten 10-by-10-foot, 6-inch-thick panels (or thinner, larger ones). Creatures where it forms make a Dexterity save to move aside. Each panel has AC 15 and 30 HP per inch. If you hold Concentration the full duration it becomes permanent.

spells.name: Waves of Exhaustion
spells.text: A gray glow surrounds you. As an action while it lasts, send a 60-foot Cone of gray light: each creature there makes a Constitution save or gains 1 Exhaustion level (it can't raise a creature above level 4 with this spell).

spells.name: Yolande's Regal Presence
spells.text: A 10-foot Emanation of majesty. Creatures you choose that enter it or start or end their turn there make a Wisdom save (once per turn): 4d6 Psychic damage, Prone and pushed up to 10 feet on a failure, or half damage on a success.

spells.name: Arcane Gate
spells.text: Create two linked 10-foot portals within range, one within 10 feet of you. Anything entering one exits the other. You can rotate them as a Bonus Action.

spells.name: Blade Barrier
spells.text: A wall of whirling blades (up to 100 feet long, 20 high and 5 thick, or a 60-foot-diameter ring) gives Three-Quarters Cover and is Difficult Terrain. A creature entering it or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d10 Force damage (half on success).

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.text: A bolt strikes a target and leaps to up to three others within 30 feet of it. Each makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d8 Lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
spells.higher: One more leap per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Circle of Death
spells.text: Each creature in a 60-foot-radius Sphere makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Material: black pearl powder worth 500+ GP.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 2d8 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Conjure Fey
spells.text: A Medium Fey spirit appears and makes a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet: 3d12 + your spellcasting modifier Psychic damage and Frightened until the start of your next turn. As a Bonus Action on later turns you teleport it 30 feet and attack again.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d12 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Contingency
spells.text: Store a spell of level 5 or lower that targets you, with a trigger you describe. When it happens, the stored spell takes effect immediately. Material: a gem-encrusted statuette of you worth 1,500+ GP.

spells.name: Create Undead
spells.text: Cast at night on up to three Medium or Small corpses to raise Ghouls under your control for 24 hours. Recasting renews control. Material: one black onyx worth 150+ GP per corpse.
spells.higher: Level 7: four Ghouls. Level 8: five Ghouls or two Ghasts or Wights. Level 9: six Ghouls, three Ghasts or Wights, or two Mummies.

spells.name: Dirge
spells.text: A 60-foot Emanation of mourning that creatures you choose can ignore. Others make a Constitution save: on a failure 3d10 Necrotic damage, Prone and 1 Exhaustion level; on a success half damage and Speed halved. Affected creatures can't regain Hit Points.

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.text: A green ray: the target makes a Dexterity save or takes 10d6 + 40 Force damage. A creature reduced to 0 HP is turned to dust. It destroys a Large nonmagical object or a 10-foot Cube of it, and a Wall of Force.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 3d6 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Drawmij's Instant Summons
spells.text: Mark an object up to 10 pounds with an invisible sigil on a sapphire worth 1,000+ GP. Crushing the sapphire as an action summons the object to your hand from anywhere on the same plane.

spells.name: Elminster's Effulgent Spheres
spells.text: Six spheres orbit you. Spend one with your Reaction when you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage to gain Resistance to it until your next turn, or as a Bonus Action hurl one (ranged spell attack, 120 feet) for 3d6 damage of a type you choose.
spells.higher: One more sphere per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Eyebite
spells.text: Each turn, as a Magic action (including when you cast it), one creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or suffers Asleep (Unconscious), Panicked (Frightened, Dashes away) or Sickened (Poisoned).

spells.name: Find the Path
spells.text: You know the shortest, most direct physical route to a fixed location you name on the same plane. Material: divination tools worth 100+ GP.

spells.name: Flesh to Stone
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save or is Restrained, repeating the save each turn. Three successes end the spell; three failures turn it to stone (Petrified) permanently if you keep Concentration the full minute.

spells.name: Forbiddance
spells.text: Ward up to 40,000 square feet against teleportation and planar travel, and choose creature types (Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, Undead) that take 5d10 Radiant or Necrotic damage when entering or starting a turn there. Material: ruby dust worth 1,000+ GP.

spells.name: Globe of Invulnerability
spells.text: A 10-foot Emanation barrier: spells of level 5 or lower cast from outside can't affect anything inside it.
spells.higher: Blocks one more spell level per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Guards and Wards
spells.text: Ward up to 2,500 square feet: fog in corridors, arcane locks on doors, webs on stairs, misleading paths, plus an extra effect such as Dancing Lights, Magic Mouth, Stinking Cloud, Gust of Wind or Suggestion. Casting it daily for a year makes it permanent.

spells.name: Harm
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save, taking 14d6 Necrotic damage on a failure (half on success). The damage can't reduce it below 1 HP, and on a failure its Hit Point maximum drops by the damage for 1 hour.

spells.name: Heal
spells.text: A creature regains 70 Hit Points and is cured of Blinded, Deafened and Poisoned.
spells.higher: Healing increases by 10 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Heroes' Feast
spells.text: A feast for up to twelve creatures, eaten over an hour. For 24 hours each has Resistance to Poison, immunity to Frightened and Poisoned, and +2d10 Hit Point maximum and current HP. Material: a gem-encrusted bowl worth 1,000+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Leomund's Lamentable Belaborment
spells.text: A tedious lecture: creatures in a 10-foot-radius Sphere make an Intelligence save or are Charmed by you for the duration. Creatures that don't share your language or have Intelligence below 3 succeed automatically.

spells.name: Magic Jar
spells.text: Your soul moves into a gem container; from there you can try to possess a Humanoid within 100 feet (Charisma save). While possessing it you use its body with your mind. Material: a gem worth 500+ GP.

spells.name: Mass Suggestion
spells.text: Up to twelve creatures that understand you make a Wisdom save or follow a reasonable suggestion of up to 25 words.
spells.higher: Level 7: 10 days. Level 8: 30 days. Level 9: a year and a day.

spells.name: Move Earth
spells.text: Every 10 minutes, reshape dirt, sand or clay in a 40-foot square: raise or lower it, dig trenches, build walls. It doesn't affect stone or move creatures violently.

spells.name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
spells.text: A frigid globe explodes in a 60-foot-radius Sphere: each creature makes a Constitution save, taking 10d6 Cold damage (half on success). It freezes water. You can instead hold it as a globe to throw later.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed and dances: it must use all its movement dancing, has Disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attacks, and others have Advantage on attacks against it. On a success it dances only until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save each turn.

spells.name: Planar Ally
spells.text: Ask your deity or a powerful entity for aid: it sends a Celestial, Elemental or Fiend loyal to it, which helps with a task in exchange for payment proportional to the risk.

spells.name: Programmed Illusion
spells.text: Create an illusion of an object, creature or phenomenon (up to a 30-foot Cube) that plays a scripted 5-minute performance when a trigger you set occurs.

spells.name: Summon Dinosaur
spells.text: Summon a Huge dinosaur spirit (Ankylosaur, Triceratops or Tyrannosaur) that acts after you, obeys your spoken commands and Dodges otherwise. Its stats scale with the spell's level.
spells.higher: 10 more HP per level above 6, and Multiattack equals half the slot level.

spells.name: Summon Fiend
spells.text: Summon a Fiendish Spirit (Demon, Devil or Yugoloth) that obeys you and acts after you. Its stats scale with the spell's level. Material: a bloody vial worth 600+ GP.
spells.higher: Uses the higher slot level in its stat block.

spells.name: Sunbeam
spells.text: A 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line of sunlight. Each creature in it makes a Constitution save, taking 6d8 Radiant damage and being Blinded until your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success. Repeat it as a Magic action on later turns. You shed Bright Light 30 feet.

spells.name: Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron
spells.text: A cauldron holds copies of a Common or Uncommon potion you choose, up to your spellcasting modifier in doses. You or an ally can draw one as a Bonus Action; unused potions vanish at the end.

spells.name: Transport via Plants
spells.text: Link a Large or larger living plant within range to another on the same plane you have seen or touched. Any creature can step into one and out of the other using 5 feet of movement.

spells.name: True Seeing
spells.text: A willing creature gains Truesight 120 feet: it sees through illusions, Invisible creatures, shapechangers' true forms and into the Ethereal Plane. Material: mushroom powder worth 25+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Wall of Ice
spells.text: A wall of ice (ten 10-foot panels or a 10-foot-radius dome). Creatures where it forms make a Dexterity save, taking 10d6 Cold damage (half on success). Each panel has AC 12 and 30 HP; breaking one leaves frigid air that deals 5d6 Cold to creatures moving through.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 2d6 (and the frigid air by 1d6) per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Wall of Thorns
spells.text: A wall of thorny brush up to 60 feet long, 10 high and 5 thick (or a ring) that blocks sight. Creatures where it forms make a Dexterity save, taking 7d8 Piercing damage (half on success). Moving through costs 4 feet per foot, and a creature entering or ending its turn there makes the save again for 7d8 Slashing.
spells.higher: Both damages increase by 1d8 per slot level above 6.

spells.name: Wind Walk
spells.text: You and up to ten willing creatures turn into clouds: Fly Speed 300 feet (hover), Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing, and only Dash or a Magic action to revert (which takes 1 minute).

spells.name: Word of Recall
spells.text: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet teleport to a sanctuary you designated beforehand (a temple of your deity or similar).

spells.name: Aura of Evasion
spells.text: You and creatures in a 30-foot Emanation have Advantage on Dexterity saves. On a Dexterity save that normally halves damage, a success means no damage and a failure means half.

spells.name: Conjure Celestial
spells.text: A 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder of celestial light. For each creature in it you choose healing light (4d12 + your spellcasting modifier HP) or searing light (Dexterity save, 6d12 Radiant, half on success), once per turn when it appears, moves into or a creature enters or ends its turn there. You move it 30 feet on your turn.
spells.higher: Healing and damage increase by 1d12 per slot level above 7.

spells.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
spells.text: A bead of fire waits at a point; when the spell ends it explodes in a 20-foot-radius Sphere: Dexterity save, 12d6 Fire damage plus 1d6 per turn you kept it, half on success. A creature can pick up and throw the bead.
spells.higher: Base damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 7.

spells.name: Divine Word
spells.text: Creatures you choose make a Charisma save. A failed one with 50 HP or fewer suffers by its current HP: 0-20 dies, 21-30 Blinded, Deafened and Stunned for 1 hour, 31-40 Blinded and Deafened for 10 minutes, 41-50 Deafened for 1 minute. Celestials, Elementals, Fey and Fiends that fail are sent home for 24 hours.

spells.name: Etherealness
spells.text: You step into the Ethereal Plane and can move through objects and see the Material Plane in gray, out to 60 feet.
spells.higher: Three more willing creatures within 10 feet per slot level above 7.

spells.name: Finger of Death
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save, taking 7d8 + 30 Necrotic damage (half on success). A Humanoid killed rises as a Zombie under your command.

spells.name: Fire Storm
spells.text: Up to ten connected 10-foot Cubes of fire. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save, taking 7d10 Fire damage (half on success). You can exclude plants.

spells.name: Forcecage
spells.text: An invisible cube prison (bars or solid box) traps creatures in a 20-foot Cube (or 10-foot box). Nothing physical passes; teleporting out requires a Charisma save. Material: ruby dust worth 1,500+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Fractured Awareness
spells.text: A creature makes an Intelligence save: on a failure 12d10 Psychic damage and Disadvantage on D20 Tests, repeating the save at the end of each turn; on a success half damage and the spell ends.

spells.name: Mirage Arcane
spells.text: Make terrain up to 1 square mile look, sound, smell and even feel like another kind. You can make paths impassable or ponds seem solid; Truesight sees the real terrain.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
spells.text: A shimmering door opens to an extradimensional mansion with up to 50 rooms, food for 100 and 100 servants. You choose who can enter.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Sword
spells.text: A spectral sword appears. When you cast it and as a Bonus Action on later turns, move it 30 feet and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it: 4d12 + your spellcasting modifier Force damage. Material: a miniature sword worth 250+ GP.

spells.name: Plane Shift
spells.text: You and up to eight willing creatures travel to another plane, or you banish an unwilling creature with a melee spell attack and failed Charisma save. Material: a forked metal rod worth 250+ GP.

spells.name: Power Word Fortify
spells.text: Share 120 Temporary Hit Points as you like among up to six creatures you can see.

spells.name: Power Word Pain
spells.text: A creature takes 6d8 Force damage. If it has 100 HP or fewer, it is Charmed: Speed at most 10 feet, Disadvantage on D20 Tests except Constitution saves, and it must pass a Constitution save to cast a spell. It repeats the save each turn.

spells.name: Prismatic Spray
spells.text: Each creature in a 60-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save and is struck by a random color (1d8): Red Fire, Orange Acid, Yellow Lightning, Green Poison, Blue Cold (12d6, half on success), Indigo (Restrained, may Petrify), Violet (Blinded, may be sent to another plane), or two colors.

spells.name: Project Image
spells.text: An illusory copy of you appears somewhere you've seen. You can see, hear and speak through it and cast spells as if you were there (Magic action to switch senses). Material: a statuette of you worth 5+ GP.

spells.name: Regenerate
spells.text: A creature regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points, then 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns, and severed body parts regrow after 2 minutes.

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.text: A creature dead for no more than a century (not of old age) returns to life with all its Hit Points. It has a -4 penalty to D20 Tests that drops by 1 each Long Rest. Material: a diamond worth 1,000+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Reverse Gravity
spells.text: Gravity reverses in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high Cylinder; unanchored creatures and objects fall upward (a Dexterity save lets a creature grab something fixed).

spells.name: Reweave Fate
spells.text: When a creature you can see fails a D20 Test, it rerolls with Advantage and must use the new roll. If the reroll succeeds, it also gains 6d10 Temporary Hit Points.

spells.name: Sequester
spells.text: A willing creature or object is hidden from divination and becomes Invisible; a creature also falls into suspended animation. You can set a condition that ends it. Material: gem dust worth 5,000+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Simbul's Synostodweomer
spells.text: Whenever the touched creature casts a spell with a spell slot, it can roll unspent Hit Point Dice equal to the slot's level and regain that total plus your spellcasting modifier; those dice are expended.

spells.name: Simulacrum
spells.text: Create an illusory duplicate of a Beast or Humanoid with half its Hit Points that obeys you. It can't regain spell slots or heal except by repair. Casting it again destroys the previous one. Material: powdered ruby worth 1,500+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Symbol
spells.text: Inscribe a glyph that triggers when a condition you set is met, affecting creatures in a 60-foot-radius Sphere for 10 minutes: Death (10d10 Necrotic), Discord, Fear, Pain, Sleep or Stunning, each with a save. Material: diamond dust and powdered opal worth 1,000+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.text: You and up to eight willing creatures (or one object) teleport to a destination on the same plane. Accuracy depends on how well you know the place: on target, off target, similar area or mishap (3d10 Force damage).

spells.name: Transfix
spells.text: A creature within 60 feet makes a Charisma save or is Charmed: Incapacitated and drawn toward you until within 5 feet. If it ends its turn within 5 feet of you it takes 4d8 Psychic damage.
spells.higher: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 7.

spells.name: Void Star
spells.text: Ranged spell attack for 6d12 Necrotic damage. Hit or miss, the target takes 3d12 Necrotic damage at the end of its next turn and you regain that many Hit Points.
spells.higher: Both damages increase by 1d12 per slot level above 7.

spells.name: Animal Shapes
spells.text: Willing creatures you choose turn into Large or smaller Beasts of CR 4 or lower, gaining Temporary Hit Points equal to the form's HP. As a Magic action you can change their forms again.

spells.name: Antimagic Field
spells.text: A 10-foot Emanation where no magic works: spells can't be cast, magic items become mundane, summoned creatures vanish and spells' areas are suppressed.

spells.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
spells.text: An object or area up to a 200-foot Cube repels (Antipathy: Frightened, must move away) or attracts (Sympathy: Charmed, must approach) a kind of creature you name, with Wisdom saves.

spells.name: Befuddlement
spells.text: A creature makes an Intelligence save, taking 10d12 Psychic damage on a failure (half on success). On a failure it also can't cast spells or take the Magic action, repeating the save every 30 days.

spells.name: Clone
spells.text: Grow an inert duplicate of a living Medium or Small creature over 120 days. If the original dies, its soul moves to the clone. Material: a diamond worth 1,000+ GP (consumed) and a sealable vessel worth 2,000+ GP.

spells.name: Control Weather
spells.text: Change the weather within 5 miles outdoors: precipitation, temperature and wind, one stage at a time, taking 1d4 x 10 minutes per change.

spells.name: Demiplane
spells.text: A Medium shadowy door opens to a 30-foot-cube room of wood or stone, new or one you made before. When the spell ends, creatures inside can stay or are expelled Prone nearby.

spells.name: Dominate Monster
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save (Advantage if fighting you) or is Charmed and follows your telepathic commands. Each time it takes damage it repeats the save.
spells.higher: Level 9: up to 8 hours.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.text: A 100-foot-radius area shakes and is Difficult Terrain. Creatures there make a Dexterity save or fall Prone; concentrating creatures make a Constitution save or lose it. Structures take 50 Bludgeoning damage per turn and fissures open.

spells.name: Entrancing Mirrors
spells.text: Up to three creatures make an Intelligence save: on a failure 7d6 Psychic damage and Stunned (Speed halved), repeating the save each turn; on a success half damage.

spells.name: Glibness
spells.text: When you make a Charisma check, you can replace the roll with a 15. Magic that would detect whether you're lying shows you as truthful.

spells.name: Holy Aura
spells.text: Creatures you choose in a 30-foot Emanation have Advantage on all saves and attacks against them have Disadvantage. A Fiend or Undead that hits one with a melee attack makes a Constitution save or is Blinded. Material: a reliquary worth 1,000+ GP.

spells.name: Holy Star of Mystra
spells.text: As a Bonus Action on later turns, make a ranged spell attack within 120 feet for 4d10 + your spellcasting modifier Force or Radiant damage. You have Three-Quarters Cover and can use your Reaction to reflect a single-target spell of level 7 or lower at its caster.

spells.name: Illusory Dragon
spells.text: A Huge shadowy dragon appears; enemies who see it make a Wisdom save or are Frightened. As a Bonus Action move it 60 feet and breathe a 60-foot Cone: Intelligence save, 6d6 damage of a type you choose (half on success).

spells.name: Incendiary Cloud
spells.text: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of burning smoke, Heavily Obscured. Creatures there when it appears, entering or ending a turn there make a Dexterity save, taking 10d8 Fire damage (half on success). It drifts 10 feet each turn.

spells.name: Iron Body
spells.text: A willing creature gains Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing and Fire, immunity to Poison damage and to Paralyzed, Petrified and Poisoned, and can't gain Exhaustion. Material: diamond dust worth 250+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Lightning Ring
spells.text: A 10-foot Emanation of storms: creatures entering it or starting or ending a turn there make a Constitution save, 3d6 Lightning and 3d6 Thunder damage and Deafened 1 minute (half on success). As a Magic action fire a 60-foot Line: Dexterity save, 6d6 Lightning.

spells.name: Maze
spells.text: Banish a creature into a labyrinthine demiplane. As its action it can make a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check to escape.

spells.name: Mind Blank
spells.text: A willing creature is immune to Psychic damage, Charmed, and any effect that reads its thoughts or locates it, even Wish.

spells.name: Moment of Prescience
spells.text: When you fail a D20 Test, change the roll to a 20; or when a creature hits you with an attack roll, change that roll to a 1.

spells.name: Power Word Stun
spells.text: A creature with 150 HP or fewer is Stunned, repeating a Constitution save at the end of each turn. One with more HP has its Speed reduced to 0 until your next turn.

spells.name: Sunburst
spells.text: Each creature in a 60-foot-radius Sphere makes a Constitution save, taking 12d6 Radiant damage and Blinded for 1 minute on a failure, or half on a success. Dispels magical Darkness in the area.

spells.name: Telepathy
spells.text: A telepathic link with a willing creature you know on the same plane: you share words, images and sensations instantly.

spells.name: Tsunami
spells.text: A wall of water up to 300 feet long, 300 high and 50 thick. Creatures in it make a Strength save, taking 6d10 Bludgeoning damage (half on success). It moves 50 feet each turn, shrinking and dealing less damage.

spells.name: Astral Projection
spells.text: You and up to eight willing creatures project astral bodies into the Astral Plane, leaving bodies in suspended animation, linked by silver cords. Material: per creature, a jacinth worth 1,000+ GP and a silver bar worth 100+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Blade of Disaster
spells.text: A blade-shaped rift appears; make up to two melee spell attacks against creatures within 5 feet of it, each 10d6 Force damage and a critical hit on 18-20. As a Bonus Action on later turns move it 60 feet and attack twice again.

spells.name: Detonate
spells.text: A creature makes a Constitution save, taking 10d10 Fire damage (half on success). Then it explodes: other creatures in a 60-foot Emanation make a Dexterity save for 10d10 Fire (half on success), with Disadvantage if the target dropped to 0 HP.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.text: A willing creature has Advantage on D20 Tests and attacks against it have Disadvantage.

spells.name: Gate
spells.text: Open a portal to another plane. Naming a specific creature pulls it through to you (no control over it). Material: a diamond worth 5,000+ GP.

spells.name: Hindsight
spells.text: Watch the last 10 years of events within range at 1 day per second, pausing, rewinding or speeding up. Material: a tiny hourglass worth 500+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Imprisonment
spells.text: A creature makes a Wisdom save or is bound: Burial, Chaining, Hedged Prison, Minimus Containment or Slumber. You set a condition that ends it. Material: a statuette worth 5,000+ GP per Hit Die of the target.

spells.name: Invulnerability
spells.text: You are immune to all damage for the duration. Material: adamantine worth 500+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Mass Heal
spells.text: Restore up to 700 Hit Points divided among creatures you can see, and cure them of Blinded, Deafened and Poisoned.

spells.name: Meteor Swarm
spells.text: Four meteors explode in 40-foot-radius Spheres. Each creature in one makes a Dexterity save, taking 20d6 Fire and 20d6 Bludgeoning damage (half on success); a creature in several is affected once.

spells.name: Power Word Heal
spells.text: A creature regains all its Hit Points and ends Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned and Stunned. If Prone, it can stand with its Reaction.

spells.name: Power Word Kill
spells.text: A creature with 100 HP or fewer dies. Otherwise it takes 12d12 Psychic damage.

spells.name: Prismatic Wall
spells.text: A seven-layered wall (or sphere) of light. Creatures within 20 feet when it appears make a Constitution save or are Blinded. Passing through applies each layer's effect in order; each layer is destroyed by a specific means.

spells.name: Shapechange
spells.text: Turn into a creature with CR up to your level, gaining its stats and Temporary Hit Points equal to its HP but keeping your mind. You can change form as a Magic action. Material: a jade circlet worth 1,500+ GP.

spells.name: Storm of Vengeance
spells.text: A 300-foot-radius storm cloud: thunder (2d6 Thunder, Deafened), then each turn acid rain, lightning bolts, hailstones and freezing wind across the area.

spells.name: Time Stop
spells.text: Time stops for everyone else: you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row. It ends if you affect another creature or an object it holds, or move more than 1,000 feet away.

spells.name: True Polymorph
spells.text: Turn a creature into another creature, a creature into an object, or an object into a creature (Wisdom save if unwilling). Held for the full hour, it becomes permanent until dispelled.

spells.name: True Resurrection
spells.text: A creature dead up to 200 years (not of old age) returns to life with all its HP, fully restored, even without a body if you name it. Material: diamonds worth 25,000+ GP, consumed.

spells.name: Vision of Elapsing Eons
spells.text: A creature makes an Intelligence save or takes 10d12 Psychic damage and is Paralyzed. Each failed save at the end of its turns adds an Exhaustion level; a success ends it. An ally within 5 feet can use an action to shake it free.

spells.name: Wail of the Banshee
spells.text: Each creature you choose in a 60-foot Emanation (Constructs and Undead are immune) makes a Constitution save. On a failure its Hit Points drop to 0; on a success it takes 10d6 Psychic damage.

spells.name: Weird
spells.text: Each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere makes a Wisdom save, taking 10d10 Psychic damage and becoming Frightened on a failure (half damage only on success). A Frightened creature repeats the save each turn, taking 5d10 on a failure.

spells.name: Wish
spells.text: Duplicate any spell of level 8 or lower without components, or ask for another effect (objects, healing, resistances, a reroll, or something greater at the DM's discretion). Beyond duplication you take stress: necrotic damage per spell you cast and a 33% chance of never casting Wish again.
